lhag ma'i rnam bzhagte/ bka' blo mi bde ba dang / gling ba dang / dran par byas pa dang / bdag nyid brjod par bya ba ma yin pa nyid du byed pa dang/ chos dang mthun pas bzlog pa dang) las brjod pa gsum pa'i mthar mi gtong ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyigma nges pa'i sde ni/ lhag ma'i rjes su/ so sor thar pa las/ dpen pa skyabs yod du 'dug pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/ dang po'i gling gzhi yul ni mnyan yod du/ gang zag 'char gas nyon mongs chags pas dpen pa skyabs yod mnyes pa sbed mar pus mo gtad de chos bstan pas ma nges pa dang po'i bslab bya 'di bcas dren/ /gnyis pa'i gleng gzhi yul rgyal po'i khab tu/ gang zag dge slong shi ri las nyon mongs pa shes bzhin ma yin pas kun nas bslangs te/ chung ma gso sbyongang 'phags la dpen pa skyabs 〈snad du chos bstan pas ma nges pa gnyis pa bcas serdzo ma nges pa'i sde la gnyis yod de/ pham lhag ltang byed gsum du ma nges pa dang / lhag ma ltang byed gnyis su ma nges pa gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ bcas ldan dge slong gis chags sems kyis kun nas blangs te/dpen pa skyabs yod du bud med dang 'dom gang gi nang du gnas pa las byung ba'i lhung ba de/gsum du ma nges pa'i mtshan nyid yin te/ de la pham lhag lhung byed gsum 'byung bar ma nges kyang 'byung du nye ba'i rgyu can yin pa'i phyig bcas ldan dge slong gis chags sems kyis kun nas bslangs te/ dpen par bud med dang 'dom gang gis bar chod pa'i phyi rol tu lhan cig gnas pa'i ltang ba de gnyis su ma nges pa'i ltang ba'i mtshan nyid yin te/ de ltar gnas pa la lhag ma dang lhung byed gnyis 'byung bar ma nges kyang 'byung nye bas de ltar brjod pa'i phyig339
'dul ba gzhistod/smras spru/thub bstan pad mo'i mtsho de rgyas gyur pa/ /skal ldan gnyis skyes ngur smig 'chang ba'i yid/ /'phrog par byed kyang ngan goms bya rog rnams/ /dri ngan mi gtsang sbags pa'i khod nas spyod/ /skye dgu'i re skong bslab gsum nor bu de/ /'dul ba 'bum sde'i mtsho chen la rol pa'i/ /gsum ldan klu dbang gtsug tu gces 'dzin pas/ /don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i gdengs mas bsgrengs/ /zhes pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /340
spang ltang thun mongab/gsum pa ltang byed kyi sde la dngos 4 spangs pa dang 'brel ba〉spang ltang dang / bshags pa tsam dang 'brel pa'i lhung byed 'ba' zhig pa gnyis/ dang 4 la bcu tshan gsum las/ bcu tshan dang po ni/ sem thar gyi sdom las/ 'chang ba 'bral ba 'jog pa dang / /'khrur 'jug pa dang len pa dang / /slong dang stod g.yogs smad g.yogs bcas/ /rin thang so sor bskur ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bcu yod de/ 'chang ba'i de/ 'bral ba'i de/ 'jog pa'i de/ 'khrur 'jug gi de/ len pa'i de/ slong ba'i de/ slong rigs kyi de/ dpags pa slong ba'i de/ so so nas dpags pa slong ba'i de/ rin bskur pa'i de dang bcu yod pa'i pyid de la thun mong gi yan lag dang / so so'i rnam bzhag gnyis/ dang 4 yod de/ 'dir bkod pa ltar so thar dang rnam 'byed las mi 'byung yang zhu ba las gsungs pa'i don/ rtsabar/ spangs pa la ni zhes 〈snags mdo lnga 'byung la/ lhag ma rnam 'byed dang phran tshegs kyi rung mthun sbyar ba dang yang yang bshad pa pa/ dī kṇi sbri jugās pa/ dzo shā (spra ( (pa dzo ༷༵ rdo ṭwāṃ ñtsha shā pa~X hūm̐ /pa mi dī shāXswā 'a/( kṣiṃ pa spya (stanā (lha hā/ dzosna ji ba ṇṭhī / sbyonge hūm̐/nga/ /gasprapa ༵ ༵ sna ṭwāṃ shāshā raṃ spra dī 9) ba'i thun mong ba dang lnga/ dang so ston par/ rtsabar/ nyin mtshan gyi dang 4 ma yin pa la tha ma ma yin pa med pa nyid do/ /gnas pa la ni bhyor ba'i snod nyid do/ /de'i dang sau ni skya rengs dang ṭo de'o/ /las la ni 'das na nyi ma shar ba'i 'o/ /zhes byung / sbyor dus 'brel gyi ltang ba la bcu dgu 'dzid de/ 'chang gnyis/ 'jog gnyis/ 'phyos gnyis/ 'bral gnyis/ gnas ngan len 'chab 341
'dul ba gzhi stogpa'i ltang ba dang / nub lhag nyal gyi dang / bud med dang lhan cig nyal ba'i dang / dmag nang du nyal ba'i dang / snang bcas su nyal ba'i dang / spang ba rjes phyogs kyi dang / snyil ba dang lhan cig nyal ba'i ltang ba ste ṭīkka'i dngos bstan bco lnga dang / shugs bstan la sngas pa gnyis dang /'chab pham reg lhung ste bzhi dang bcu dgu yod pa'i phyig de dag las zla lasdog gi de/ ras chen bzhag 'phyis kyi ltang ba/ zhag bcu 'chang ba'i de/ sman zhag bdun pa'i de/ dgon pa pa'i 'bral spang / nub lhag nyal gyi ltang ba rnams la mtshan mtha'i skad cig ma yan lag tu dgos te/ de dag rim bzhin du mtshan mo sum cu'i mtha'i skad cig ma dngaka bco lnga'i de dang / bcu'i de dngakabdun gyi de dang / drug gi de gsum gyi mtha'i de rnams yan lag tu dgos/ dus 'brel gyi lhung ba gzhan rnams skyed pa la nyin zhag re re yan lag tu yod pas tshog pa'i phyis dang po grub ste/rtsabar/ nyin mtshan gyi dang po ma yin pa la tha ma ma yin pa med pa nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i nyid khyab ste/ 'di ltang ba drug po de rnams bskyed pa'i dus la mtshan mtha'i skad cig yan lag tu dgos par ston byed yin pa gang zhig /nyin mtshan gyi dang po ma yin pa ni mtha'i skad cig ma la byed pa'i phyid dang po grub ste/ lung las/ dge slong gis tshes la chos gos rnyed dam/ zhes dang / lung las/ bcu gcig gi nyin par skya rengs shar na smrang ba'i lhung byed do/ /zhes dang /ṭīkka las/ skad cig ma gzhan ni 'dir spang pa'i yan lag ma yin gyi/ mtha'i skad cig ma gcig po de nyid nyin mtshan dang po gcig tu btsiste/ de tshun chad nas nyin zhag brtsizhing zhag bcu'am zla ba gcig gam zhag drug gam zhag bdun 'das na spang bar 'gyur bar ci rigs par sbyar bar rig par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig 'dis ni zhag gi thog ma'i dus bstan kyang mtha'i yang mjug gi skad cig ma la stos par bshad pa'i phyir/ bam lnga las/ nyin mtshan gyi dang 4 ma yin pa zhes bya ba ni nyin mtshan gyi tha ma ste zhag phyi ma'i skya rengs shar kha'i mtha'i skad cig 342
spang lhung thun mong ba/ma'o/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / rin chen phreng ba las/ des na skad cig ma gcig po de zhag tu brtsibs/ gos 'chang spang lta bu la/ nas/ lo mjug la skyes pa'i bu chung gis zla gcig las ma lon kyang lo gcig lon par brtsib bzhin/ zhes gsungs pa'i pyid gong gi rtags gnyis pa grub lte/ ṭīkka las/ nyin mtshan sgya dang po ma yin pa ste/ mtha'i skad cig ma'o/ /zhes dang /bam lnga las kyang / nyin mtshan gyi dang po ma yin pa zhes bya ba nyin mtshan gyi tha ma ste zhes dang /rin chen phreng ba las kyang / de min pa mtshan mo mtha'i skad cig ma ste/ dper na rig pa'i mi mthun phyogs la ma rig par brjod pa bzhin zhes gsungs pa'i pyid 4rtags gnyis pa dus 'brel gzhan bdun la mtha'i skad cig ma'i gron gyi dus su yang mtshan mo'i cha gsum gang rung la rgyur ba'i nyes pa skyed pa'i phyig rtsabar/ gnas pa la ni bhyor ba'i snod nyid do/ /zhes dang /ṭīkka las/ dmag gi nang na gnas pa ma gtogs pa'i gnas pa'i bslab pa'i gzhi gzhan dag la ni/ mtshan mor gtogs pa'i dus kho nar bhyor ba'i snod nyid yin gyi nyin par gnas pa ni ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang / rin chen phreng ba las/ nyal ba lnga dmag nang na gnas pa gnas ngan len 'chab pa lte/ gnas pa dang 'brel ba'i bslab pa'i gzhi bdun po la ni dus lhag ma yan lag tu mi brtsib min te zhes gsungs pa'i phyig dmag nang na gnas pa tsam gyis kyang ltang byed skyed pa'i phyig ṭīkka las/ dmag gi nang na gnas pa la ni nyin par gnas na yang lhor ba'i snod nyid kyi rgyu'i dngos po 'gyur te/ der gnas pa tsam nyid na nyes par 'gyur ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i mig 'chang langog 'bral sogs kyi nyin mtshan gyi dang po yod de/ skya rengs la/ dang 4/ bar pa/ tha ma gsum yod pa'i dang 4 shar ba nas 'odzin pa'i phyir/dang po shar ba'i tshad gnyis yod de/ nam gyi cha bgos pa'i sgo nas de shar ba'i tshad dang /mtshan ma'i sgo nas de shar pa'i tshad gnyis yod pa'i phyig nam gyi cha'i sgonas de'i shar tshad yod 343
'dul ba gzhistod/de/ nam la srod dang gung dang tho rangs gsum du phye zhing de re re la cha gsum gsum phye ba'i/ tho rangs kyi cha gsum gyi dang po'i phyed nas skya rengs dang 4 'char ba'i pyid ma'i rnam 'byed las/mtshan mo'i thun tha ma'i dang po'i phyed pa na rnga rdung du nye ba na skya rengs shar ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyid gnyis pa yod de/tho rangs gling 'de'i shar phyogs kyi nam mkha' gro skyar gyur pa'i dus skya rengs dang 4 shar ba'i phyir/ der thal/ shar phyogs kyi nam mkha' gro skyar snang ba skya rengs dang po ldo rengs dang / shar phyogs kyi nam mkha' skya la cung zad dmar ba ni skya rengs gnyis pa ser rengs dang / skya rengs tha ma shar ba dang rgyu skar 'od med cing 'o zi'am dmar rengs zhes bshad pa'i pyid 'od ldan du drangs pa las/ skya rengs dang pho shar nas ni/ /shar phyogs su ni gror snang zhing / /skar ma'i gdong gi 'od nyams la/ /nam mkha' sngo skyar gyur pa yin/ /nas/ skya rengs tha ma 'o zir bshad/ /'o zi nyi ma shar bar du'o/ /zhes dang / skya rengs dang po shar ba na nam mkha' dkar sor snang do /gnyis pa shar ba na ser por snangacad /gsum pa shar ba na dmar por snang ngo / /zhes dang/ de bzhin du shes rab byed pa las kyang / skya rengs gsum gyi gro rengs ni/nyi ma'i 'od 'dzam bu'i slor babs pa na de'i lo ma'i 'od kyis nam mkha'i mdog ldo bar gyur cing/ser rengs ni nyi ma'i 'od 'dzam bu la phog pa na 'dzam bu'i 'od kyis nam mkha' mdog ser por 'gyur ba dngan dmar rengs ni nyi ma nam mkhar byung ba na nam mkha'i mdog dmar por 'byung ba yin zhes gsungs pa'i phyis de la kha cig/shes rab byed pa'i de mi 'thad par thal/nyi ma'i 'od 'dzam bu'i slor babs pas mtha' 〈sna skya 'byung ba 'brel med yin pa'i pyid der thal/ 'dzam bu'i shing 'dzam gling 'de'i dbus na gnas pa'i phyis zhes shing rta chen ṭo dag la'ang dgag pa mi shes bzhin du byedado/ /de 'brol med padang/ lapam bu bṛkṣa lamam gling gidabus khonarayod pa gnyis shin tu mi 'thad par thal/ 'dzam bu gling gi byang ngos rgya mtsho'i 'gram na shing gron pa 'dzom bu 344
spang lhung thunamong ba/zhes bya ba 'ongs tshod yang chen yo yod pas/ de'i ming gis gling 'di la lasam gling du bshad pa'i phyir te/ rnam 'byed kyi 'grel bar slob dpon dul ba lhas/ 'dzam bu gling gi byang gi ngos rgya mtsho'i 'gram na shing ldon pa 'dzam bu zhes bya ba bongs tshod chen po yod pa de'i ming gis gling 'di 'dzam bu gling du zhes bya bar shes pa'i shing de'i 'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig yon tan 'od kyis kyang 7do'i bzhed pa drangs shing / dus lhangor nas byang nas byang du 'od tra rgya nag sogs bshad pas kyang shes dgos la/ phyogs gcig na shing de yod pas gzhan na med par 'dod pa yang shin tu dka'/ yang kha cig /mtshan po'i sum cha lus pa na skya rengs dang po 'char zer/gzhan dag lnga cha lus pa na skya rengs dang yo 'char zer ro/ /rigs pa ma yin te zhes dgag pa nyin mtshan mnyam pa med par thal ba 'phen pa shin tu tha chad yin par thal/ de dang dus mnyam du sde pa kha cig 'dod pa shākya 'od kyis kyang bkag la de 'dra'i khyad par ma phye bar 'gog mi rung ba'i pyir/ der thal/ mtshan mo'i sum cha lus pa dang dus mnyam du skya rengs dang po mi 'char yang sum cha'i nang du 'char ba'i phyir te/ gso sbyordzong bzhag pa'i gzhi las/ btsun pa mtshan mo'i thun tha ma la rnga rdung du nye ba'i mtshan mo skya rengs 'char ba'i dus kyi tshod la babs pas da ni ring por mi thogs par skya rengs 'char lags na/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyis khyab ste/ de'i don mtshan mo'i thun tha ma de mtshan mo'i cha gsum pa yin pa'i phyis 'od ldan las/ thun tha ma ni nam gyi cha gsum pa yin no/ /bab ste ni thug ste'o/ /cha tha ma de la skya rengs 'char ba'i dus yin par khong du chud par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig yang kha cig/sum cha lus pa sbyor btang dang / lnga cha lus pa bye brag bshad mtsho'i lugs dang mtshan mo ring dus la sbyodar ba mi 'thad par thal/ de sde pa gzhan gyi 'dod tshul dang / sde pa bye brag bshad mtsho'i bshad tshul yin pa'i phyir/ 'od ldan las/ sde pa gzhan dag na de ni thun tshod bzhi'i cha'i lhag ma dang bcas pa ni mtshan mo'i thun tha 345
'dul ba gzhi stogma yin zhing thun tshod la rnga brdung bar bya'o zhes 'chad do/ /zhes pa nas/ lnga cha lus pa na skya rengs 'char ro zhen/ nas/ mtshan mo'i lnga cha lus pan skya rengasadang posanarna lasade skad kyang mi 'byung ngo zhes gsungs pa'i phyid des na nyin mtshan ring thung gang yin kyang mtshan mo'i thun tha ma'i cha gsum gyidang po'i phyedanas 'char bas lung las kyang mi 'dra ba ma bshadado lasadapyod ldan rnams kyis shes par bya'o/ /lhag ma'i zhib cha dus tshigs su bshad zin to/ /deyang sgo gtan las gzhan 'chang lasdog 'bral gsum dang dbyar dgag gso sogs dang dus rung gi thog ma sogs kyi nyin mtshan gyi thog ma skya rengasadang po shar ba nas 'dzin la sgo gtan bslab pa la skya rengs tha mdagos te/ rang nyid gling gang la gnas pade'idabang dude ltaradagos pa'i pyirate/ rtsabag de'idang po ni skya rengs dang po de'o/ /zhes dang/ sum brgya pa las kyangaka rang gling skya rengs dang po nas bzung nas/ /nyi ma phyed bar 'di ni dus yin te/ /zhes dang/ṭīkka las kyang/ mtshan nyid 'dini chos gos dang bral ba la sogs padag la dgosate/nyi ma bcu gcig gi skya rengs shar na'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes dang]'od ldan las/don 'di la ni skya rengs tha ma yin par dgongs so/ /zhes gsungs pas de'i pyir sgo gtan las gzhan du ni skya rengs dang po kho nar bzhed pa yin pas skya rengasadang yo smos pasan no zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang] lung gtam gyi gzhi las/ btsun pa re zhig shar gyi lus 'phags gling du 'tshalan/des dus gang gis 'tshal bar bgyi/de rnams kyi dus gang yin pas so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyis 'di dusadang dus min du rung ba'i nyin mtshan bcas pa tsamayin gyi skya rengasadang po'i dus nyin dus mtshan nyid pa minate/rnam 'byodadang shākya 'od kyis mtshan mo'i thun tha maralangayang bshad pa'i phyir dang/ 'od ldan las kyangalha gnas pa'i dus kyis 'dor dusadang dus min par rgyu bdagadang bsod snyoms la 'bro ba la sogs pa'i rnam par bzhag pasan gyi zhes gsungs pa'i migadesan brjed pa sogs kyisadabyaradagag gso grang tshes bco 346
spang lhung thun mong ba/lnga'idang por ma gruban 'dzig rten padangaganas tshod ltar bcudrug gi nyi ma shar ba'i sngon tsam lalang de dag rung lte/ rtsabad las la ni 'das na nyi ma shar ba'i'o/ /zhes dang/ṭīkka las/ tshes zhes bya ba'i skya rengs shar du rin kyang ji srid du nyi ma shar bar ma gyur nade'i tshe gso sbyong la sogs pa'i las bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyidgnyis pa ni/ rtsabad spang pa la ni 'du shes las gtso cher rang gi nyid do/ /de ni bgros pa nyid na bral ba nyid do/ /rab tu byung ba'i don du nges par byas pa yang de nyid do/ /chos gos las kyang rnam par brtags na'o/ /'di la rjes su zhugs pa nyid kyang nyams pa yin no/ /rang bzhin las nyams na yang ngo / /zhes byung / 'chang 'bral 'jog sogs kyi spang ltang bskyed pa la dngos po de rang dbang zhing bdag tu 'dzin pa zhig dgos te/ gzhan gyi rdzas la gzhan gyi yin par 'du shes pa dang / gzhan gyi de la rang gir 'du shes pa dang / rang gi de la gzhan gyir 'du shes gsum gang la'ang dngos gzhi mi bskyed pa'i phyig rtsabag spang ba la ni 'du shes las gtso cher rang gi nyid do zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bdag 'grel gyi lhung ba thun mong ba bco brgyad yod de/ 'chang lasdog 'khrar 'jug lnga/ 'thag 'jug ras chen brtad mtha' gsum ste brgyad dang bcu tshan bar pa dang bco brgyad yod pa'i phyir te/ rin chen phreng ba las/ bdag po dang 'brel ba'i thun mong ba ni/ 'chang 'angog 'jug 'phyis brgyad dang bcu tshan bar pa lte zhes gsungs pa'i pyig spang ltang de bco brgyad mi 'byung ba'i thabs khyad par can gsum yod de/ rang gi yin kyang zhe thag pa nas gang zag gam dge 'dun gzhan la bgros na de mi 'byungaka rab byung gzhan gyi ched du yin na pyin rlabs sam rnam brtags med par de bzung yang de mi 'byung] chos gos dang yo byad la rnam brtags kyi cho ga byas na'ang spang lhung mi bskyed pa'i phyig dang po grub lte/ de la rnam brtags dang byin rlabs gang rung ma byas kyang de mi 'byung ba'i sgyig rtsabag de ni bsngos pa nyid 347
'dulab gzhi stodna zhes gleg/ /gnyis pa grub ste/ rtsabs rab tu byung ba'i don du zhes sesna/ /gsum pa grub ste/ rtsabag tshos 〈snas las kyang rnam par brtags na'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rnam brtags byed tshul yod de/ bam lnga las/ rung bar bya ba'i cho ga dang sngags ni dge slong gi mdun du 'greng ste/gnyis gas gos kyi grwa nas bzung nas 'di skad ces brjod par bya ste/ tshe dang ldan pa dgongs su gsesnal/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i gos lhag pa rung bar ma byas pa rung ba bya bar 'os pa 'di mkhan po la rung bar bgyi'o/ /mkhan 4 la yid gtad de bcang bar bgyi'o/ /rkyen ji lta ba bzhin du bgyi'o/ /zhes pa lan gsum bzlas/ mkhan ṭo las gzhan pa zhig la rung bar bya na yang che ge mo zhes ming brje bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyid bdag 'brel gyi ltang ba 'di la bgros pa dang rnam brtags kyi thabs kyis yo byad rang la rjes su zhugs pa ste/shan 'byung bdang shan rdeg pa gnyis ka nyams pa'i phyir/ rtsabag 'di la rjes su zhugs pa nyid kyang nyams pa yin no zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/gsum pani/ rtsabag dege'od na dngos po de ltabu gzhan lalang 'byung ba nyid do/ /zhag bdun pa la ni rigs mthun pa la'o/ /lhung ba de 〈snad na/ yo byad tsam bdag gir byas pa la spang ba nyid do/ /zhes byung / 'dir shan la de gsungs pa'i dgos pa dang / mtshan nyid dang] rnam grangs dang //shā lha /dris paX rnyi (spra lha/shā dī ṭwā pa/ twā]ryaṃ dīspra paX rsha dī ba dzee/(( spya hūm̐ /su/ spripa pas de 'dag pa'i ched du spang ltang phyir bcos la brtson pa'i ched yin pa'i phyig gnyis pa ni/rjeg byed des rang gi brdeg bya la nyes pa zhugs pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i shugs de/ shan gyi mtshan nyid yin te/ shan gsum gar khyab pa'i spyi'i 'jog byed yin pa'i phyig bam lnga'am 'dul ba kun las btus las/ rjes su zhugs pa nyid de yod na phyis rnyed pa'i dngos po de lta bu gzhan 348
spang ltang thun mong ba/la yang 'byung ba nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyis rnam 'grel las/ brjod bya'i shan gyi khyad par las/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar brjod bya rjod byed kyi shan yang yod pas spyir nyes pas ma khyab ṭo/ /gsum pa rnam grangs yod de/ shan dang / rjes zhugs dang / rgyun 'brel dang / shugs rnam grangs yin pa'i sgyig sgra don ni/ snga ma'am gzhan gyi byed pa zhugs pas na shan dang/ de'am de'i dbang gis gyur pas na rjes zhugs dre gas yin pa'i pyir/ ṭīkkas bshad pa las 〈sna/ /bzhi pa 'dir shan la dbye na gos kyi shan/ lhung bzed kyi shan/ sman gyi shan/ lhung ba'i shan dang bzhi yod/rsharsha shā ༵ /sna (dzo dī (dī spra liṃ ṭwāṃ /spya ṅgi dzño /surjo pasdi rnyi( )nyirshas lha sgri shā/ ga~X sbyo shan dang sor 'du ba'i phyig gtso bor rdzas snga ma'am gzhan stobs kyis gos par byas pa'i ltang ba'i gzhi'i rdzas de rdzas shan gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na gos lhung sman gyi shan gsum yod/ kha cig/skabs 'di'i shan la nyis pa'i rdzas mi dgos zer ba mi 'thad de/ rdzasade'i nyes pa min pa'i shan nam rjes zhugs skabs 'dir dpyod don med pa'i phyir te/ shan rdeg tshul gyis shes pa'i phyir/ lhung ba dngos gzhi ma bskyed gong du'ang nyes pa skyed pa'i phyir/ gos de rang gi snga ma'i shugs sam gzhan gyi shugs kyis spang ltang byed pa'i rdzas su song ba de gos kyi shan gyi mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi zhag bcu 'chang spang gzhan stobs kyis bskyed pa'i gos lta bu dang / zla langog gi de gzhan stobs kyis skyed pa'i kha skong gi gos lta bu gnyis/ lhung bzed dang sman yang mtshan nyid de ltar sbyor rigs te/ rtsabag de yod na dngos po de lta bu gzhan la yang 'byung ba nyid do zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ dngos po de lta bu smos pas rang dang 'dra ba la shan bdegs kyi mi 'dra ba la mi brdegs pa'i phyir/ bam lnga las/ de lta bu'i dngos po la ste/ 'di lta ste/ bo sa zhag bcur gtogs pa ni zhag bcu pa la 'byung ba nyid do/ /zla ba gcig par gtogs pa ni zla ba gcig pa 349
'dul ba gzhi stod/la'o/ /lhung bzed du gtogs pa ni lhung bzed la'o/ /sman zhag bdun par gtogs pa ni sman zhag bdun pa 'byung ba nyid ltabu'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i nyida'o na ltang ba de yod na yo byad tsam bdag gir byas pa la spang ba nyid do zhes gsungs pa dang 'gal zhe na mi 'gal lte/ spang ltang bshags pa'i tshe phal bas dngos po phyis rnyed rigs na mthun mi mthun spang dgos kyang phyis rnyed rigs mi mthun la spang ltang mi 'byung ba'i pyid bam lnga las/ dge slong des gal te phyis rigs mthun pa'am mi mthun pa'i kho byad tsam rnyed na de'i tshe bshags pa'i dus na dge slong des de yang spang bar bya'o/ /de'i phyir nyung ba ni bshags pa bya mi dbosnas/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyig des na rdzas shan dang zhag shan dang dus shan gsum ming gi rnam grangs yin/ yang byin rlabs dang ma 'brel ba'i rang gi brdeg bya'i yo byad la nyes pa gos par byas pa'i zhag shan de zhag shan khyad par can ma yin pa'i mtshan nyid/ brdeg bya pyin gyis ma brlabs pa'i zhag shan dang / zhag shan khyad par can ma yin pa rnam grangs/ bdeg bya byin rlabs can la nyes pa gos par byas pa'i zhag shan de zhag shan khyad par can gyi mtshan nyid/ zhag shan khyad par can dang / bdeg bya byin rlabs can la //sdu two( lha sha/ nypha ghnā /spri lta/pa shā sna spya 1 sna dhri ༵ gne ba/shā dzo ghnā spra rshas/ byi( na la/ /dri /spya mi 'byung ba du ma yod pa dang/ dge slong de la spang ltang byung yang spang shan mi 'byung ba yod pa shes pa'i ched yin pa'i phyig dang 4 grub ste/ rtsabar/ ltang ba de yod na yo byad tsam bdag gir byas pa la spang pa nyid do/ /zhes dang / ṭīkka las/ lhung ba de 〈snad na zhes bya ba ni spang ba'i ltang byed de yod na'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang / bam lnga las/ ma bshags pa la phyis 'ang byad rigs mthun pa'am mi mthun pa ci yang rung ba zhig rnyed cing/ bdag gir byas na spang bar bya dgos pa nyid 'byung gi lhung ba ni mi 'byung ngo / /zhes dang / ṭīkka las/ spangs pa nyid do zhes bya ba ni spang 350
spang ltang thun mong ba/bar bya dgos pa nyid 'byung lhung ba ni mi 'byung ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig des na spang shan ltang shan khyad par shin tu che ba ma go snangayod /lana'i spangadagos kyi shananam shugs byungakhang nyes shan dang zhag shan gang yang ma yin te/ de'i ltang ba mi 'byung ba'i phyigaṭīkka las/ de'i gzhi las ltang ba mi 'byung ba'i phyis zhes gsungs pa'i phyid bam lnga las kyang cad /de la ltang shan ma byung yang spang ltang snga ma'i shan nam shugs kyis spang dgos pa'i phyis 'di'i thad kyi lung las/ ltang ba de yang ma bshags par gzhan zhig rnyed na de yang spangs pa yin te/ snga ma'i shugs kyis so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rang gi yo byad tsam zhes pa'i tsam sgra'i don la 'grel chung las/skud pa tsam yan chad kyang spang dgos zhes pa mi 'thad par thal/ spang dgos kyi gos kyi chung mtha' ngos kun nas khu gang yin pa'i phyis rnam 'byed las/ spangs pa rnams kyi gos tha ma ni khra gang kho ra khor yug go/zhes dang /ṭīkka las/ khru gang khor yug las chung ba'i phyir dang/ chung ba ni spang bar 'os pa ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ ②rtags gnyis pa grub lte/gang zag khyad par can la spang lhung byung yang bshags dus dngos po spang mi dgos pa'i pyid khyad par can de phyir bcos la brtson pa'i phyir dang / phyir bcos kyi rtsabar/ ngo tsha dang ldan pa dang /mdo sde 'dzin pa dngaka 'dul ba 'odzin pa dang / ma mo 'odzin pa dang shes pas ni gcig gi mdun du bshags pas dge 'dun lhag ma las 'dag go/zhes gsungs pa'i phyis des na kha cig rdzas zhan/ zhag shan/ ltang shan gsum byed pa mi 'thad par thal/ rdzas la ma ltos pa'i zhag shan dang zhag la ma stos pa'i rdzas shan mi rnyed pa'i sgyig rdzas med par zhag 'ba' zhig gis shan gyi spang lhung med pa'i phyid ltang shan gyi ngo 4 yod de/ spang lhung byung nas ma bshags kyi bar la yo byad kyi rdzas spang dgos pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i nyis pa rgyun 'brel de de yin pa'i phyis rin chen phreng ba las so/ /drug pa la 'dres tshul dang] lhung ba skyed tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ shan 'tshes tshul 351
'dul ba gzhi stod/yod de/ gos kyi/ lhung bzed kyi/ sman gyi/ lhung ba'i shan 'dris tshul bzhi yod pa'i pyid gos lhung sman gsum gyi shan 'dres dus yod de/ de gsum snga ma la rjes zhugs yod pa la phyi ma gsum nam rnyed pa'i dus der shan zhugs zin pa'i mig ṭīkka las/ tshes la chos gos rnyed la tshes lnga'i nyin par chos gos de rnam par brtags par byed dam gro bar byed na phyis de'i nyin mo nyid la chos gos gzhan zhig rnyed kyang snga ma'i shan des shan 'dres par mi 'gyur te/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyab lte/ de byin gyis ma brlabs na gos de rnyed pa dang shan 'dres par shugs la bstan pa'i phyig rin chen phreng ba las/ rdzas shan 'dris dus ni brdeg bya de nam grub pa na shan 'dres pa yin te/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyid gnyis pa ni/ de gsum re re la'ang khyad par can ma yin pa dang khyad par can gnyis gnyis yod/ dang 4 la zhag bcu 'chang spang gi de dang / zla lezhug gi shan gnyis/ dang po la gnyis las/ khyad par can ma yin pa ni byin gyis ma brlabs pas byin gyis ma brlabs pa la shan 'dres pa ste/ tshes gcig la sargar gsum khebs pa yan chad kyi gos shig rnyed pa byin gyis ma brlabs par bzhag /tshes gnyis nas dgu'i bar gos gzhan rnyed pa byin gyis ma brlabs par tshes bcu gcig gi skya rengs dang 4 shar ba dang snga ma la/ rang stobs kyis zhag bcu'i 'chang spang dang / pyi ma la snga ma'i shan stobs kyis zhag bcu'i 'chang spang 'byung ba'i phyig tsabag byin gyis brlabs padang ma 'brel ba la'o/ /zhes dang /ṭīkka las/ rang nyid kyi rjes su zhugs pa dang bcas pa'i gos ni gnyis te/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/gnyis pa khyad par can la byin gyis ma brlabs pa'i gos kyis pyin gyis brlabs pa'i gos la shan 'dris pa ste/ 'di la dus mnyam pa'i shan dang / mi mnyam pa'i shan 'dris tshul gnyis/ dang 4 ni/ tshes gcig la gos gnyis rnyed pa'i gcig byin gyis brlabs pa la cig lhastos byin gyis ma brlabs par bcu gcig gi skya rengs shar ba'i tshe byin gyis ma brlabs pa la rang stobs dang]352
spang lhung thun mong ba/byin gyis brlabs pa la ma brlabs pa'i mnyam pa'i shan stobs kyis zhag bcu'i 'chang spang skyed pa'i phyir/ ṭīkka las/ gang gis nyin gcig kho nar dus gcig tu chos gos gnyis bdag gir byed la chos gos gcig ni byin gyis rlob par byed la/ cig shos ni mi byed na de la ni chos gos de gnyis ka zhag bcu ladas na spang ba kho nar 'gyur te/ zhes dang / rin chen phreng ba las/byin gyis ma brlabs pas brlabs pa la bdeg pa'i skabs su snga ma'am dus mnyam pas brdeg cing / phyi mas brdeg pa med do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyid mi mnyam pa'i shan brdeg tshul du ma yod de/ tshes gcig la gos tshad longs rnyed pa byin gyis ma brlabs par bzhag /tshes drug la rigs mthun kyi gos rnyed pa byin gyis brlabs kyang tshes bcu gcig gi skya rengs shar ba'i tshe/snga ma la rang stobs dang phyi ma la gzhan gyi shan stobs kyis 'chang spang skyed pa gang zhig /tshes gcig la gos tshad longs rnyed pa byin gyis ma brlabs par bzhag pa tshes lnga la gos rigs mthun phyi ma zhig rnyed pas tshes drug la gos phyi ma byin rlabs sogs ma byas par gos snga ma byin gyis brlabs kyang tshes bcu gcig gi skya rengs dang ṭo shar ba na gos phyi ma de la snga ma'i zhag bzhi'i tshon dang rang gi zhag drug gi rang stobs bsdoms nas zhag bcu'i 'chang spang skyed par rnam 'byed las bshad pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ rtsabar/ 'di la gzhan yod na byin gyis ma brlabs pa de'i shan tshun chad nas so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub ste/ rin chen phreng ba las/ gos 'chang ba ltabu'i skabs su/ zhes pa nas/ gos snga ma rung bar byas sam bsdos kyang gos phyi ma la de dag ma byas na zhag bzhi'i shan dang drug gi rang stobs bsdoms pas spang ba skyed de/ rnam 'byed du zhes sogs gsungs pa'i pyid gnyis pa zla lasdog gi gos shan la gnyis las/ khyad par can ma yin pa ni tshes gcig la gtor gsum khebs pa'i tshad du ma longs pa'i gos gcig rnyed pa byin gyis ma brlabs/ tshes gnyis nas sum cu'i bar gos gzhan tshad 353
'dul bgazhi stod/longs ma yin pa rnyed pa byin gyis ma brlabs par tshes so gcig pa'i skya rengs shar ba'i tshe snga ma la rang stobs dang phyi ma la shan stobs kyis zla 'jog gi spang ba skyed pa'i phyid gnyis pa khyad par can la sngar ltar mnyam pa byin gyis ma brlabs pas brlabs pa la dang / byin gyis ma brlabs pa snga mas byin gyis brlabs pa phyi ma la shan brdeg tshul snga ma las dpag ste shes par bya la shes byed kyang thun mong ba yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ lhung bzed kyi shan la yang khyad par can ma yin pa dang yin pa gnyis dang shan 'dris tshul dang zhan ltang skyed dus gos kyi medon pa brje ba ma gtogs zhag bcu'i 'chang spang ltar shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa sman shan la/ zhag bdun pa'i de/ thun tshod du rung ba'i de/ ji srid 'tsho bcang gi shan byed tshul dang gsum/ dang 4 la khyad par can dang/ khyad par can ma yin pa'i de gnyis/ dang poni tshes gcig la bu ram gnyis dus mnyam du rnyed pa'i gcig byin gyis brlabs cig phyosnas ma brlabs par za ba'i phyir bzhag pa zhag brgyad pa'i skya rengs shar ba'i tshe snga ma byin gyis brlabs pa'i bu ram la rang stobs/ byin gyis ma brlabs pa la shan stobs kyis zhag bdun pa'i gsog langog gi spang ba 'byung ba'i phyig rtsabadde yod na dngos po de lta bu gzhan la yang 'byung ba nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig 'di gos sman lhung bzed thams cad kyi shan 'chad byed yin pa'i phyigaṭīkka las/ gnyis ka yang nyin gcig kho nar bdag gir byas pa'i phyis zhes dus mnyam par gsungs pa'i rung mthun yin pa'i sgyidyang tshes gcig la mar gcig rnyed pa byin gyis brlabs/ tshes gnyis la mar gzhan snyed pa byin gyis ma brlabs par bza' phyir bzhag pa zhag brgyad pa'i skya rengs shar ba na zhag 'dun pa'i smrang ba 'byung ste/ de yang mar gyis mar 'o/ dngaka 'bru mar gyis 'bru mar la dang / bu ram gyis bu ram sogs rang dang rigs gcig pa dgos/ zhag bdun par rigs gcig lta bus mi chog pa'i phyir/ rtsabag zhag bdun pa la ni rigs mthun pa la'o/ /zhes so/ /'di la shan brdeg bya 354
spang ltang thun mong ba/rdeg byed gnyis ka byin rlabs can dgos par 'dod pa mi 'thad par thal/ rnam 'byed las/ dge slong gis tshes la mar rnyed la/ des tshes gnyis la gzhan zhig kyang rnyed par gyur na/ des snga ma zugs bza' bar bya zhing] phyi ma zugs btang bar bya ba'am rung bar bya ba'am/ gzhan la sbyin par bya'o/ /gtong bar mi byed dam/ rung bar mi byed dam/ gzhan la sbyin par mi byed na zhag brgyad pa'i skya rengs shar na spang ba'i lhung byed do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyis khyab lte/ rung bar bya ba byin rlabs sogs mi byed na spang ba skyed par bshad pa'i phyig ṭīkka las kyang / zhag bdun pa la ni zhes bya ba ni mar dang 'bru mar la sogs pa'i rdzas zhag bdun pa nyid du spyan gyis brlabs pa la'o/ /rigs mthun pa la'o zhes bya ba ni phyis rnyed pa'i rdzas kyi rigs mthun pa'i rang bzhin 'dra ba la zhes gsungs pa'i phyig des rang gis sman pyi ma gsum la byin rlabs can mayin pa yod pa ma shes pas nongs pa yin pas dor bya kho na'o/ /'o na/ṭīkka las/ byin gyis ma brlabs pa de zhag bdun ladas par 'chang du zin kyang nyes pa med de/ rung ba'i phyir gser la sogs pa dang 'dra'o zhes gsungs pa mi 'thad par thal/ shan brdeg bya rdeg byed gnyis dar byin rlabs can mi dgos pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ de ni shan dang ma 'brel bar byin len dang phyin rlabs gang yang ma byas pa'i bu ram zhag bdun pa de yang rung ba gsum gang rung byas na zhag bdun las lhag 'chang yang nyes pa mi 'ong ba/ rung ba gsum byas pa'i gser sogs bzhin zhes pa'i don yin pa'i pyigaṭīkag rung ba'i pyid zhes pa'i don yod pa'i pyid gnyis pa thun tshod ni/ skyu ru ra'i khu ba rnyed pa snga dro zun tshod bar byin gyis brlabs te/ gung yol nas phyu ru ra'i khu ba rnyed pa byin len byasate byin gyis ma brlabs par bzhag pa thun tshod gyi mtha' mtshan mo'i thunadang po 'das tshe snga mas rang stobs dang phyi mas shan stabs kyis gsog lajug gi spang ltang skyed pa'i phyis 'do la ldag byed khyad par can ma yin pas shan bzag pa med de/ thun tshod sman byin rlabs kyi dus 355
'dul ba gzhidabe/snga dro khonaranges shing] snga dro skyu ru ra'i khu ba gnyis rnyed pa shun tshod du byin gyis brlabs pa phan tshun shan mi brdeg par thun tshod kyi mtha' 'das tshe gsog gzhug gi spang ltang skyed pa'i phyig nad ji srid 'tsho bcang gi sman gyi shan khyad par can ni dus mnyam pa tshes gcig la a ru ra gnyis rnyed pa'i gcig nad ji srid 'tsho bcang du brlab cing cig shos ma brlabs par bzhag pa nad sos shing zhag gi mtha'i skya rengs dus snga mas rang stobs dang/cig 〈snas kyis shan gyis gsog langog gi spang ba skyed/ mi mnyam pa snga ma byin rlabs can gyis phyi ma brlabs pa la yang nad 〈snas tshe snga mas rang stobs phyi mas shan gyis dren/ /khyad par can ma yin pa ni tshes gcig gi nyin a ru ra rnyed pa nad 'tsho bcang du brlabs/ tshes phyi ma gang rung la rnyed pa yang der byin gyis brlabs te bzhag /de nad ldums tshe gzhan la ster ba sogs ma byas par nad 〈snas pa'i zhag gi mtha'i skye rengs shar tshe gsog lasdog yin pa'i pyid 'de dag la 'phags yul na'ang 'dod tshul yod kyang slob dasan yon tan 'od dang chos bshes kyi bzhed pa dri med yin pa'i phyir te/ rang gi rnam bshad las/ dus su rung ba dang shun tshod du rung ba dang 'tsho ba'i bar du bcang pa rnams la skyon gyis rung ba ma yin pa nyid du gyur pa la zhag bdun pa las bye brag 'ga' yang med do/ /'dir zhag bdun pa zhes smos pa dpe tsam du rig par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang/ṭīkka las kyang / zhag bdun pa zhes bya ba smos pa ni dpe tsam du zad par rig par bya'o/ /zhes dang/ dus su rung ba dang thun tshod du rung ba dang / zhag bdun pa dang / 'tsho ba'i bar bcang pa la sogs pa gsog 'jog byas pa de dag thams cad ni ji ltar zos na ltang byed du 'gyur ba de bzhin du 'chang na spang ba'i ltang byed du 'gyur te/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na nad ji srid 'tsho bcang la shan 'byung yang srid mee ji srid 'tsho bcang gi sman la shan brdeg pa med de/ dge slong tshe 'phos ma thag tu ltang ba mi 'byung ba'i phyigades na sman gyi shan rjeg byed yin na sman byin 356
spang lhung thun mong ba/rlabs can gyis khyab ste/ bslab bya gnam rtsed ldeng las/ gzhi'i yan lag rnam pa bzhi las gang rung yin pa/ nas/ ngo 4 ma rdzogs pa ma yin pa/ rang ngam rang dang 'dra bas byin len dang byin rlabs gang rung byas pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyis khyab lte/ byin len dang byin rlabs gang rung med na gzhi'i yan lag mi tshang la/ des na mthar thug kyang ji bzhin mi 'byung ba'i phyir te/ mthar zug gi tshad yang/ bslab bya gnam rtsed ldeng las/ mthar thug spyan rlabs med pa'i sman bzhi po snga dro byin len byas pa gung tshigs 'das pa dang / phyi dro byin len byas pa zun tshod las 'das pa dang / byin rlabs can rang rang gi byin rlabs kyi dus las 'das pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyid sngar bshad pa thams cad la'ang byin rlabs dang shan med par rang stobs kyis smrang ba'i ltang ba skyed tshul 'dis shes par gyis/ dpyod ldan rnams la legs bshad kyi dga' ston dang rnam dpyod sgo brgya phye yod pas gces par gyis shig /'de dag la mtha' dbyad na/ kha cig zhangzhungargyal bas shes/ dang la la na re/ mag rol ran/ zhag bcu/ zhag bdun pa'i spang ba 3nags la/ zhag re re lhag dgos te/ zhag bcu'i 'chang spang la zhag bcu gcig 'da' dbodzis/ bdun pa la brgyad (lha kau 'a//tsha ghnā ༵ :dzo hā kāX pa'/|lha pa'i 337 /〉lha rdzu sbra ༈ rnyi pa~X snar/ kṣiṃ zhes gsungs pas so 3da de la rtsabad gzhan gyi nyi ma'i dang po la'o/ /zhes gsungs pa des/zhag bcu las gzhan bcu gcig pa'i nyin zhag gi dang 4 la zhag bcu 'chang spang 'byung bar bshad pa mi 'thad par thal/ zhag bcu gcig 'da' dgos pa de'i phyig gzhan yang / rnam 'byed las/nyi ma bcu gcig pa'i skya rengs shar na spang ba'i ltang byed do zhes gsungs pa mi 'thad par thal/bcu gcig pa thal dbosnas pa'i nyid gzhan yang / rnam 'byed las/ nyi ma sum cu rtsagacig pa'i skya rengs shar na spang ba'i ltang byed du gsungs pa mi 'thad par thal/ zhag so gcig pa'i thog mar 357
'dul ba gzhirnabmi 'byung bar so gcig 'da' dgos pa'i phyis kha cig /sman zhag bdun pa byin gyis brlabs pas lhung ba khegs pa zhig med par thal/ de byin gyis brlabs pas shan bdeg pas zhag mthar gsog lezhug skyed pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ rtags sla/ 'dod mi nus lte/ zhag bdun gyi mtha' tshun gyi gsog 'jog gi lhung ba khegs pa'i phyig rtsabar/ spyan gyis brlabs pa la gsog gzhug mi 'byung ngo zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bdun pa gos rigs mu bzhi ngos bzung ba na/ chos gos /susna rsha bya( kṣiṃ sno pazloshā kau bushā ghnā )snro 'a/rnyi nd+ra ṭwāṃ lharsha pad /sgyuji shā ༵༵ /kā dog thams cad pa nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ kha gsog gi re ba med pa dang chos gos rnam gsum yod pa'i gang zag la stos te khra gang gi tshad tsam du longs ba'i gos kyang zhag bcu 'chang spang gi lhung ba skyed pa'i botos yin te/ de la kha gserdzog gi re ba 81da na zla lasdog gi bosnas yin pa'i phyir/ rtsabar/ kha bskang ba la re ba med na chung ba khra gang yan chad kyang chog pa dang 'dra'o/ /byin gyis brlab par bya ba yod pa nyid na yang ngod /gzhan du na de ni zhag sum cu 'das na'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig de yang dar ser 4 kha gsog rnyed pa la dmar 4'am sngon 4 sogs kha dog mi mthun pa rnyed kyang re ba gcod mi nus te/ de gnyis bsdebs nas chos gos gcig byar mi rung ba'i pyig rtsabag kha dog la sogs pa las rigs mi mthun pa ni chog pa nyid ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyid gos rigs bzlog mi bzlog gi shan la mu bzhi yod de/ rigs log shan 'byung gi gos dang] rigs log shan mi 'byung ba'i de/ rigs mi bzlog shan mi 'byung ba'i de/ rigs mi bzlog shan 'byung ba'i gos dang bzhi yod pa'i mig dang 4 ni/chos gos gsum med pa'i dge slong gis tshes gcig la khra gang gi tshad longs rung ba'i gos gcig rnyed pa/ kha skong re ba dang bcas te/ tshes bcu'i snga rol gyi tshes la chos gos yongs 358
spang ltang thun mongab/rdzogs rnyed de kha skyong gi re ba med pa'i tshe na tshes gcig rnyed pa'i gosade rigs log shan 'byung gi nas su 'gyur te/ sngar zla lasdog gi gos yin pa las bzlog nas zhag bcu gcig pa'i skya rengs shar tshe zhag bcu 'chang spang rang stobs dang chos gos la shan stobs kyis skyed pa'i phyisgnyis pa ni/ chos gos med pa'i dge slong gis tshes gcig gi tho rangs la khu gang tshad longs kha gsog gi gos gcig rnyed/ phyi dro chos gos gcig rnyed nas kha skong gi re ba med tshe gos snga ma de rigs bzlog shan mi 'byung ba'i gos yin te/ de sngar zla lajug gi rigs las bzlog nas zhag bcu gcig pa'i skya rengs shar ba na gnyis gas rang stobs kyis zhag bcu 'chang spang gnyis skyed pa'i phyir/ rtsabar/ de rnyed nas zhag bcu pa de'i dang 4 la bag la slon pa nyid do zhes 〈sna/ /gsum pa ni chos gos med pa'i dge slong gis tshes gcig la khra gang tshad longs kha skong re ba dang bcas pa gcig rnyed/ tshes gnyis nas sum cu'i bar gos gzhan ma rnyed pa'i tshe gos de rigs mi bzlog shan mi 'byung ba'i gos yin te/ de sngar zla langog gi spang ba skyed pa'i gos yin zhing / da lta'ang rigs der gnas la phyi nas shan brdeg bya'i gos ma rnyed pa'i phyid bzhi pa ni/ chos gos med pa'i dge slong gis tshes gcig la khra gang tshad longs kha gsesnag gi gos gcig rnyed/ tshes gnyis nas sum cu'i bar la'ang de 'dra'i kha gsog gi gos gcig rnyed pa ma brlabs pa'i tshe gos snga ma de rigs mi bzlog la shan 'byung ba'i gos yin te/ gos snga ma de sngar zla 'jog gi gos yin pa ltar rigs ma log cing / so gcig pa'i skya rengs shar ba na gos snga mas rang stobs dang phyi mas shan stobs kyis zla langog gi spang lhung skyed pa'i phyis bzhi pa phyir bcos dang 'brel ba'i thun mong ba ni/ chung ba nyid kyi dum bu de ni mi 'gyur ro/ /dge 'dun gyi yang ngo / /'di la med pa de nyid gtso bo'o/ /zhes byungaka spang lhung phyir bcos byed pa'i tshe khra gang las chung ba'i gos kyi dum bu dang/ dge 'dun gyi chos gos dang / gang las spang ltang 'byung ba'i 359
'dul ba gzhidabogos lhung gzhan la byin nas med pa btsal nas spang dgos pa ma yin par bshad pa ltar yin te/snga ma spang rin med/ bar pa rang gcig pu la midabang/ phyi mde spangs pa'i gtso ṭo yin pa'i pyidrang dbang ba khra gang yan chad de'i tshe gnas dang dus ci rigs sgo nas spang dgos te/ de rang gi gnas las gzhan du spang dgos/ dus re zhig spang ba'am gtan du spang ba gang rung dgos pa'i phyid lnga ba dang 4 gsum gyi yan lag zun mong ba ni/ rtsabag 'di gsum ni sra brkyang bting ba la mi 'byungacas /zhes byungaka 'chang gnyis 'bral ba'i spang ba las/ gsum 4 'di sra brkyang bting bzhin pa'i dge slong la mi 'byung ste/ sra brkyang gis bgayangs su gnas par gnang ba'i gang zag yin pa'i phyid360
spang lung soza' rnam bzhaggnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i yan lag ni/ rtsabag yod na'o/ rang gi nyid do/ /zhag bcur rjes su zhugs pa nyid do/ /gzhan gyi nyi ma'i dang po la'o/ /gos la'o/ /gagar gsum khebs pa'i mtha'i tshad la'o/ /byin gyis brlabs pa dang ma 'brel ba la'o/ /zhes byung / 'di la gleng gzhi/ rgyu mtshan/ ngo 'o gsum/ gling gzhi bcas gnang gnyis las bcas pa'i de ni/ yul mnyan yod du gang zag dge slong rab tu mang pos/ nyon mongs zang zing la gdu ba/ nyes pa thos bsam sgom pa'i bya ba shor ba la brten nas chos gos gsum las lhag par 'chang na spang lhung ngo / /zhes bcas/ gnang ba'i de ni yul rgyal po'i khab tu/ gang zag kun dga' bo la/ nyon mongs dang nyes pa ni med la/ dge slong gis zhag bcu'i bar du gos lhag pa rung ba ma byas par bcas pa gnang ngo / /zhes gnang bar mdzad pa'i mig bam lnga las/ de la 'chang ba'i gling gzhi ni bcas pa dang gnang ba'i dbang gis rnam pa gnyis te/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyid gnyis pa rgyu mtshan sla/ gsum pa ni/ dge slong gis gzhi rang dbang ba'i gos gshor gsum khebs pa yan chad dang chos gos gsum dang bcas pa gang rung byin gyis ma brlabs pa la bsam pa 'du shes ma gabrul bas rgyur ba rang stobs shan stobs gang rung gis zhag bcur 'chang bas mthar shug bcu gcig pa'i thog mar skyed pa'i ltang ba dngos gzhi de zhag bcu 'chang spang gi ltang ba'i mtshan nyid yin te/ 'di'i yan lag gi gtso 'o rang gir bzung ba'i gos dang byin gyis ma brlabs pa yin la/ yan lag bdun yang ma tshang na na smad pa'i phyig bam lnga las/ 'di la yan lag bdun gyis dngos gzhi'i ltang bar 'gyur te/ rang gi dang / gos dang] lhagar gsum khebs pa'i mtha'i tshad dang / yod pa dang/ byin gyis ma brlabs pa dang / zhag bcur rjes su zhugs pa dang/ zhag 361
'dul ba gzhi stodbcu gcig pa'i skya rengs shar ba'o/ /zhes so/ /lado la lhor lhung med de/ lan dang 'jog sogs brgyad la tshad bzung nas de bar nyis med du gnang ba'i phyir/ gnam rtsed ldeng ma las 'chang 'bral 'jog pa gsum dang lhung bzed 'chang ba dgon pa pa'i 'bral ba/ ras chen dang dbyar rnyed bzhag 'phyos/ gsog gzhug gi spang ba lte/ brgyad po rnams gnang la tshad bzung yin pas spyor ltang med la zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang/ kyor spom med la rgyur ba la nyes byas su bam lngar bshad do/ /'di la mdog dkar 'byam khra'o/ /nag 'byam nag 'byam chen por 'dod pa dag la shes byed med pas ma spros/gnyis pa 'bral spang gi ltang ba ni/ rtsabad byin gyis rlabs pa dang / gnang ba ma thob pa ni byed pa po nyid do/ /de'i gnas nye nasar dang bcas pa nas gzhan na gnas pa la skya rengs shar na'o/ /mtshams byas pa la ni mtshams gnas skya mtha'o zugags byung] gling gzhi/ rgyu mtshan/ltang ba'i rnam bzhag gsum las/ dang 4 la bcas gnang gnyis las/ bcas pa'i ni yul mnyan yod du gang zag dge slong rab tu mang 4/ nyon mongs chos gos med par stod g.yogs tsam gyis ldongs rgyu ba/ nyes pa ni rang gi lus ma sbas pa dang gzhan gyi bya ba shor ba la brten nas nub gcig chos gos gsum gang rung dang bral bar mtshams kyi phyi rol tu gnas na spang ba'i lhung byed do/ /zhes bcas/ gnang ba'i de ni yul rgyal po'i khab tu/ gang zag ni tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen 4 dang / shā ri'i bu la nyon mongs dang nyis pa med par 'od srung rgas pa dang / shā ri'i bu rlung nad can la snam sbyar dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ba'i gnang ba gnang ba'i phyig bam lnga las/ 'bral ba'i spang ba'i gleng gzhi yang bcas pa dang gnang ba'i dbang gis rnam pa gnyis te/ zhes gsungs pa'i pyid rgyu mtshan ni dge slong gi rtags nyams pa dang chos gos chud zos kyi nyes pas so/ /gsum pa ni/ dge slong gis gzhi byin gyis brlabs pa'i chos gos gsum gang 362
spang ltang so so'i rnam bzhagrung du'ang tshad ldan 'jigs bcas ma yin par rang gi gnas kyi nye gangor dang bcas pa las gzhan yin pa sra brkyang dang ma 'brel ba la bsam pa der 'du shes shing ma zhakhrul bzhin du 'bral 'dod ma log pas sbyor ba zhag gcig 'bral bar byed pa'i mthar thug zhag phyi ma'i skya rengs shar ba la brten pa'i lhung ba dngos gzhi de/ chos gos dang bral ba'i 'bral spang gi mtshan nyid yin te/byed pa po byin gyis brlabs pa dang gnang ba ma thob pa yin/ yan lag lnga ma tshang na na smad pa'i pyid bam lnga las/ 'di la yan lag lngas dngos gzhi'i lhung bar 'gyur te/ gnang ba ma thob pa dang / byin gyis brlabs pa dang / chos gos gnang ba dang / gnas nye lha'or dang bcas pa dang zhag gcig 'bral ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ nye gabor gyi gnas tshad du ma yod de/ sgyir btang du khang pa de'i khor yug kun 'dom gang tshun chad nye gshor dang] dmigs bsal rtsig pa med pa dang shing gi yal ga dag 'brel lam thog 'brel na rgyang grags gcig tshun chad nye lnga'or yin la/ chu nam mkha' sogs bar du zhugs na rtsab na yod kyang nye gshor ma yin pa'i phyir/ rtsabag nyi dngor ni kho ra khor yug tu 'dom re re'o/ /zhes dang / yang rtsabad mtshams med pa'i lam du tha dad ma yin par 'gro ba'i mi la ni 'dom bzhi bcu rtsadagu'o/ /dbus nas rgyang grags kyi mtha' phan chad ni tha dad pa nyid do/ /zhes dang / mtshams gzhan ni ma yin no/ /zhes so/ bam lnga las/ nam mkha' dang chu la sogs pas chod na mtshams gzhan ni drung na 'dug kyang nye gangor ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyiggsum pa zla 'angog gi spang ba ni/ rtsabag kha bskang ba la re ba med na chung ba khu gang yan chad kyang chog pa dang 'dra'o/ /byin gyis rlabs par bya ba yod pa nyid na yang ngo / /gzhan du na de ni zhag sum cu 'das na'o/ /zhes byung / 'di la gsum las/ gling gzhi la yul ni mnyan yod/ gang zag ni dge slong rab tu mang 4/ /nyon mongs ni zang zing la gdu ba/ nyes pa gos kyi 363
'dulab gzhiba'i/kha gsog lasdog pa la brten nas kha ga〈snag gi gos zla ba las 'das par langog na spang ba'i sgyung byed do/ /zhes bcas so/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'dod pa che ba dang / kha skong gi re bas 'bad rtsol che bas thos bsam la gnod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis so/ /gsum pa ni/ dge slong gis gzhi'i dngos po gos yin pa rgyu'i sgo nas rung ba khra gang du longs shing gshor gsum khebs pa las chung] rang dbang bar kha skong gi re ba dang bcas shing pyin gyis ma brlabs pa sra brkyang bting dus ma yin pa la bsam pa der 'du shes shing ma zhakhrul bar 'chang 'dod kyi bhyor ba rang ngam shan gang rung gi stobs kyis mthar thug zhag sum cu 'das par 'chang bas skyed pa'i ltang ba dngos gzhi de/ zla langog gi spang ltang gi mtshan nyid yin te/ yan lag gi gtso bo kha skong gi re ba yod pa dngad byin gyis brlabs pa'i chos gos gsum med pa yin pa/ yan lag lnga ma tshang na dngos gzhi'i lhung ba na smad du 'gyur ba'i phyig bam lnga las/ yan lag lngas dngos gzhi'i lhung bar 'gyur te/ gos kha skong la re ba yod pa dang / byin gyis brlabs pa'i chos gos gsum med pa dang / gos dang /tshad khra gang yan chad dang] zhag sum cu 'das pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i migbzhi pa zhakhrur 'jug gi spang lhunga'i/ rtsabad 'du shes gtso cher byed pa po nyid yin no/ /de ni shes gtso po'o/ /dge slong ma nyid dang] de nye du ma yin pa nyid dag la'o/ /pyin gyis brlabs pa rang gi rnying pa/ nas/ man chad gcig pa nyid do/ /zhes byungan 'der gsum las/ gleng gzhi yul mnyan yod du gang zag 'char das nyon mongs pa 'dod chags kyis/ nyes pa rang gi sa 'on gyis gos pa'i gos rnying ba dge slong ma nye du ma yin pa sbed mar zhakhrur bcug pas sa 'on rang gi mngal du blugs pa las bu chags pas sangs rgyas kyis de srid pa tha ma ba dge slong 'od srung gzhon nu skye bar lung bstan nas lan bcas so/ /rtsabs sbrum ma dpen par bzhag go zhes sogs byungad gnyis pa rgyu mtshan gzhan ma dad pa sogs so/ /gsum pa ni dge slong gis gzhi 364
spang ltang so so'i rnamabazhagdge slong ma dang nye du ma yin pa sogs tha snyad bdun ldan la bsam pa der 'du shes shing sbyongar ba gos rnying lubrur 'tshed 'chag gsum gang rung byed du 'jug par 'dod cing mthar thug phyogs gcig tsam yan chad byas pas skyed pa'i dngos gzhi'i ltang ba de/ zhakhrur 'jug gi smrang ltang gi mtshan nyid yin te/ gtso 'o 'du shes dang dge slong ma nye du ma yin pa dang / yan lag brgyad ma tshang na na smad yin pa'i pyid bam lnga las/ yan lag brgyad kyis dngos gzhi'i ltang bar 'gyur te/ byin gyis brlabs pa dang / rang gi dang/ rnying ba dang / zhakhrur gzhug par 'os pa dang / gos dang / dge slong ma nye du ma yin pa dang / bsgo pa dang / byas pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyis sbyongar ba gcig gis 'khur 'tshed 'chag gsum byas kyang dngos gzhi gcig skyed do/ /nye du ni bdun tsha sogs so/ /rnying ba dus tshigs su ma spyad kyang mi gtsang bas gos pas kyang skyed do/ /ṭīkka las/ chos gos bdun 4 dag las gang yang rung ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i bdun yod de/ lung las/ chos gos zhes bya ba ni bdun po bal gos dang sha na'i gos dang/ zar ma'i gos dang/ du gu la'i gos dngaka ras bal gyi gos dang/ ko tam pa'i gos dang/nyi 'og gi gos dag las gang yang rung ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyiganye du ma yin pa yan lag tu dgos pa'i ltang ba nyer dgu yod de/ bslab bya chen mo las/ zhakhrur 'jus len dang slong ba dang / /slong bar rigs dang dpags pa slong / /so sos dpags dang bal rmel dang / /mngon tshan nyo tshong lhung bzed 'tshol/ /tha ga gnyis dang gos byed dang / /gos byin 'dug gnas za ba dang / /bsod pa slong dang gcer bu steg /mgron gnyer ring 'dug ras chen tshol/ /chos ston dpen par 'dug 'greng dang / /bhyor bcug yang yang za ba dang / /do gsum tsam las lhag len dang / /bud med dang 'gro lhan cig nyal/ /so sesnar bshags pa dang 4 gnyis/ /de ltar nyi shu rtsadagu'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig 'di nyer dgu po lung dang bstan bcos re res kyang bshad pa mngon sum du grub 'o/ /dge slong mas 365
'dul ba gzhi stodskyed pa'i ltang ba bcu gsum yod de/ bslab bya chen mo las/ zhakhrur 'jug len dang bal 〉la dang / /ma bskos nyi ma nub pa dang / /gos byed pa dang gos byin dang] /mgron lam 'jug dang grur 'jugadang/ /dbeen par weng dang bhyor balcagadang] /so sor bshags padang po gnyis/ /de ltar rnam pa bcu gsum tshesna/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyislnga pa len pa'i de ni/ rtsabar/ len na'o/ /rnam par rig byed kyis sem/ /gos 〈sna/ /zhes byung / bcas pa'i gling gzhi yul mnyan yod du gang zag nyer dga' nyon mongs 'dod zhen gyis nyes pa dge slong ma nye du ma yin par gos len pas 'di bcas/ gnang ba'i gling gzhi yul mnyan yod du gang zag dge slong mang po nyon mongs dang nyes pa med par dge slong ma nye du ma yin pa la gos brje ba lasade ltar gnang ba'o/ /rgyu mtshan 'dod zhen ches pas so/ /dge slong gis nye du ma yin pa'i dge slong ma la gos nan gyis blangs pa'i lhung ba dngos gzhi de/ dge slong ma las gos len pa'i spang ba'i mtshan nyid/ yan lag lnga ma tshang na na smad yin pa'i pyid bam lnga las/ 'di yan lag lngas dngos gzhi'i ltang bar 'gyur te/ dge slong ma nye du ma yin pa dang] gos dang rung ba dang / ngag gi rnam par rig byed dang / len pa'o/ /zhes se / /nyungar ba gcig gis du ma len kyang dngos gzhi gcig go/drug pa gos slong ba'i de ni/ rtsabar/ thob na dngos gzhi'i 'o/ /chos gos so/ /zhes byung /gleng gzhi yul rgyal byed tshal du/ gang zag nye dgas/ nyon mongs 'dod zhen gyis/ nyes pa khyim bdag gcig kha chos kyis bslus te gos stso(na pa nan gyis blangs pas de ma dad pas 'di bcas/gnang ba'ini/ yul mnyanalo da gu gang zag grong phreng can gyidage slong bzhi bcu la nyon mongs dang nyes pa med par gos tshom rkun pas 'phyog pa sogs la slong ba gnang ngo/ /dge slong gis khyim pa nye du ma yin pa gos rung ba tshad ldan bslangs pa las byung ba'i dngos gzhi'i lhung ba de/ slong 366
spang rdung so so'i rnamabazhagba'i spang ba'i mtshan nyid/ yan lag lnga ma tshang na na smad de/ gos phrogs pa ma yin pas slong mi rigs pa dang / khyim pa nye du ma yin pa dang] gos rung ba tshad ldan las mi chung ba dang/ rin kha dog tshad rnams kyi gang bslang ba dang] de nyid thob pa lnga ma tshang na na smad pa'i pyid bam lnga las/'di la yan lag lngas dngos gzhi'i sgyung bar 'gyur te/ zhes pa nas/ gang bslang ba dang de nyid 'ob pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyigbdun pa slong rigs pa'i de ni/ rtsabad byin gyis brlabs pa thams cad med na slong bar rigs pa nyid do/ /zhes sogs dang /thob na dngos gzhi'i 'o/ /zhes dang] sbyin par bya ba mi sbyin na yang rga /zhes byung/ gling gzhi yul mnyan yod du gang zag grong phreng can gyi dge slong bzhi bcu dang drug sde rnams nyon mongs ma brtags par spyod pa dang 'dod zhen gyis nyis pa drod mi shes pas slong ba na 'di bcas so/ /dge slong chos gos byin rlabs can med pas slong rigs kyang khyim pa nye du ma yin par stod g.yogasadang smad g.yogs zung tshad lhag pa thob pa'i lhung ba dngos gzhi de/ slong rigs pa'i spang ba'i mtshan nyid/ yan lag lnga ma tshang na na smad yin pa'i phyir te/gos de med pas slong rigs pa dang/ khyim pa nye du ma yin pa dang] stod g.yogs smad g.yogs tshad las mi chung ba dang / de gnyis las lhag pa dang / len pa dang lnga dgos pa'i phyid bam lnga las/ 'di la yan lag lngas dngos gzhi'i ltang bar 'gyur te nas/ de dag las yan lag ma tshang na ci rigs par na smad do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyis 'tsho ba'i 'dzi byad bcu gsum byin rlabs can gang med pa slong rigs pa la stod g.yogs smad g.yogs gnyis yod de/ ma dras pa'i khyim pa'i stod g.yogs sam/ snam phran glegs bu med pa'i bla gos che tshad srid du khra bcu gnyis dang zheng du khra gsum yin/ ma dras pa'i khyim pa'i smad ga〈snags sam ma dras pa'i snam phran med pa'i mthang gos che tshad srid du khra bdun dang zheng du khu do yod pa de yin pa'i pyid rtsabag khyim pa'i 367
'dul ba gzhi stobstod g.yogs che tshad ni ras yug chen khu bcu gnyis pa'o/ /smad g.yogs ni ras yug phran bdun pa dang do ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyid bam lnga las/ stod g.yogs smad g.yogs dang bcas pa ni rnam pa gnyis te/ khyim pa'i dang] dge slong gi'o/ /de gnyis smos pa ni dge slong gos 'chang bar gdod pa rnam pa gnyis kyi dbang du mdzad pa'i phyig zhes gsungs so/ /'de la zhabrul nas chos gos snam phran dang glegs bu med pa ma 'chos shig /'di dag gzhi smad du bshad yod/brgyad pa dpags pa slong ba'ide ni/ rtsabad dpags pa ma phul bar shes pa ni ma dpags pa dang 'dra'o/ /de nyid gzhan yin no/ /zhes byung/ gling gzhi yul mnyan yod du gang zag nye dgas nyon mongs 'dod zhen gyis nyes pa khyim pa pho mo la rang gi blos dpags pa'i ras yug las bzang ba bslangs pas 'di bcas so/ /dge slong gis nye du ma yin pa'i khyim bdag la rang gis blos dpags pa'i yo byad las lhag pa bslangs pa'i lhung ba dngos gzhi de dpags pa slong ba'i spang ba'i mtshan nyid/ yan lag lnga ma tshang na na smad yin te/ gos brlag pa sogs ma yin pas slong mi rigs pa dngamanye du ma yin pa dang / tshad rung ma dpags par shes pa dang / de bslang ba dang / de nyid thob pa lnga dgos pa'i pyid bam lnga las/ 'di la yan lag lngas dngos gzhi'i ltang bar 'gyur te/ zhes 〈sna/ /dgu pa so so nas dpags pa'i de ni/ rtsabad sbyin par byed pa spungs che ba yang rga /zhes byung] /gling gzhi yul mnyan yod du gang zag nye dgas nyon mongs 'dod zhen gyis/nyis pa khyim pa pho mo gnyis la rang rang gis blos dpags pa'i ras yug las bzang ba re re blangs pas 'di bcas/ dge slong gi nye du ma yin pa'i khyim pa pho mo so sos dpags pa las lhag pa'i gos re thob pa'i dngos gzhi'i de/ so so nas dpags pa'i de'i mtshan nyid/ yan lag lnga'i gzhan snga ma ltar las so so nas re re len pa dang re re thob pa dgos pa'i phyid bam lnga las/ 'di yan lag 368
spang lhung soza' rnam bzhaglngas dngos gzhi'i lhung bar 'gyur te/ zhes dreg/ /bcu pa bskur ba'i de ni/ rtsabar/ bskul ba dang bsdad pa lhag gam khas ma blangs na'o/ /blangs na'o/ /zhes byung / gling gzhi yul mnyan yod du/ gang zag nye dgas nyon mongs 'dod zhen gyis/ nyes pa bram ze zhig gis pa na drug cu rgyas sprus pa spos 'tshong la bcol ba'i rgyus khye'u de la pa na drug cu'i chad pa byung bas 'di bcas 36/ /dge slong gis chos gos rin 'ong rgyu de zhal ta ba la bskul ba gsum dang bsdad pa gsum tshan gnyis las lhag bzhi pa gang rung byas nas gos blangs pa'i dngos gzhi'i de/ bskur ba'i spang ba'i mtshan nyid/ yan lag lnga ma tshang na dngos gzhi mi skyed de/ bam lnga las/ yan lag lngas dngos gzhi'i lhung bar 'gyur te/sbyin bdag dang pho nya dang zhal ta byed pa gsum char mi nyid dang / khyim pa nyid yin pa dang / gos kyi rin rung ba ma yin pa spangs pa dang / bskul ba dang bsnad pa lhag pa dang / sbyon par byed pa'i ༷༷ ༷༷ twā ༷ ṭwāṃ sbyoX/ ༷༷ shuX spya ༷nā ༷ /nāṃ /lha/shī/ / ༷/ keṃ/ rde ṭwāṃ//gni/ (dī/ len/ /mngon tshan can dang nyo 'tshongacad /zhes gsungs pa spang ba bcu tshan gnyis pa'amad de/ srin bal gyi de/ bal nag 'ba' zhig gi de/ cha gnyis bsres pa'i de/ lo drug nang gi de/ mtho gang gi de/ bal thogs pa'i de/ bal mel 'jug gide/ gser dngul la reg pa'ide/ mngon tshan gyi rgyud pa'ide/nyo tshong byed pa'i spang ba dang bcu yod pa'i phyig bcu gcig pa srin bal gyi stan byed pa'i spang ba ni/ rtsabag srin bal gyi stan byas sam byed du bcug na'o/ /zhes byung] gling gzhi yul mnyan yod du gang zag dge slong mang 'os nyon mongs pa 'dod zhen gyis/ nyes pa srin bal gyi stan gsar pa byas pas gzhan ma dad pa la 'di bcas serdzo/ /dge slong gis srang bcu las lhag 369
'dul ba gzhi stobpa'i srin bal gyi stan rang ngam bskos pa gang rung gis byas pa bkram pa'i dngos gzhi'i lhung ba de/ srin bal gyi stan byed pa'i spang lhung gi mtshan nyid/ yan lag ma tshang na na smad 'dra ste/ bam lnga las/ yan lag lngas dngos gzhi'i ltang bar 'gyur te/ srin bal dang / gsar pa dang / stan dang]byas pa dang] byed pa mthar zug pa'i dang po bkram pa nyid do/ /zhes so/ /tshad gding ba ltar ro//bcu gnyis pa bal nag 'ba' zhig gi stan byed pa'i spang ba ni/ rtsabag lug gi bal nag po 'ba' zhig dag go/rang bzhin gyis so/ /gron po dang 'dam kha dang] kham pa dag kyang de nyid do/ /zhes byung/ gleng gzhi yul mag yod so gang zag dge slong mang mas nyon mongs gdod zhen/nyes pa lug bal nag sa 'ba' zhig gis stan gsar pa byed pas 'di bcas so/ /lhung ba'i mtshan nyid srin bal dang 'dra ste rang bzhin gyis gnag pa dang sngo ba dang ladam kha dang kham pa gang byas kyang 'dra ba'i pyid bam lnga las/ nag po bzhi ste/ zhes sesna/ /yan lag ma tshang na na smad yin te/bam lnga las/ yan lag lngas dngos gzhi'i ltang bar 'gyur te/ lug bal nag 4 'ba' zhig dang /gsar pa dang] stan dang / byas pa dang / byed pa mthar thug pa'i dang po bkram pa nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyigbcu gsum pa cha gnyis ni/ rtsabad de dag phyed pas lhag pa nyid na'o/ /zhes byung / gling gzhi yul mnyan yod du gang zag dge slong mang pos nyon mongs 'dod zhen gyis nyes pa gshob bal cung zad dang bal nag po 'ba' zhig gis stan gsar pa byed pas 'di bcas so mtshan nyid nag po phyed las lhag pa'i stan byed pa dang gzhan tshad sogs 'dra ste/ yan lag ma tshang na na smad pa'i phyir/ bam lnga las/ yan lag lngas dngos gzhi'i ltang bar 'gyur te/ lug bal nag 4 dag phyed pas lhag pa nyid dang gsar pa dang/ snyan dang byas pa dang / byed pa mthar thug pa'i dang 4 bkram pa nyid do/ /zhes so/ /370
