'dul ba gzhi smad/drug ni kyor bas 'gro ba dang / zhes sogs gsungs pa'i pyig tsartags gnyis pa ma grub na/rtsabad mtshams las 'das pa zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi dkyil lhasar chad pa dang ma'i gzhi mthun med par thal/ ma grub pa de'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ des ma lta bu drug gi 'byung dus bstan pa'i phyir te/ ṭīkka las/ dus gang gi tshe ma lta bu'i tshig drug po de dag gis de'i dkyil lubor gyi khongs su gtogs pa de chad par 'gyur zhe na/ de'i phyir mtshams las 'das pa na de 'grub 4/ /zhes bya ba smras te/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyig de bzhin du skyon shin tu sla la ma brgyad kyang mi 'thad par thal ba sogs 'phen shes par bya'o/ /gzhan yang ma brgyad po de la song ba'i mtha' can sogs brgyad byas nas de la chos gos ma byas pa'i nyi shu dang chos gos brtsams la ma zin pa'i nyi shu dang / re ba yod pa'i nyi shu dang re ba med pa'i nyi shu bshad mi rung bar thal/khyod kyis ma drug la ya gyal med par byas pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ grangs nges 'gal/ 'dod mi nus te/ lung gzhi'i sra brkyang 'jug bral gyi sdom las/ ma byas ba ni nyi shu dang / /brtsam pa dag ni nyi shu dang / /re ba yod pa nyi shu dang / /re ba med pa nyi shu ste/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/gzhan yang / rtsabad ma thos kyi bar du sogs dang / lung gzhi las/ thos pa'i mtha' can gyi sra brkyang phyung ba gang zhe na/ sogs kyis zos pa'i mtha' can gyi ma ma bshad pa ma yin par thal/ma drug las med pa'i pyid 'dod mi nus te/ ṭīkka las kyang / ma ma brgyad kyi drug sngar bshad pa dang / thos pa'i ma ma 'des bshad par bzhed pa'i phyir te/ de'i thad kyi ṭīkka las/ 'di ni sra brkyang dbyung ba thos pa'i mtha' las byung ba yin te/ 'di yang ma lta bu yin no/ /gtsug lag la sra brkyang dbyung ba thos pa'i mtha' las byung ba ni bdun yin no zhes gsungs pa 'di yin par rig par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyid536
yos kyi bzhi smras pa/byis pa'i brdol gtam ma spyad mi gtsang dogs gcod gzhan/ /nyer mkho'i mkhas gsung dogs pa'i gzer bu'i mgo /lung rigs tho bas nyer bcom cha tsam gyis/ /ngan rtog rno bral dpyod ldan rnar mi rtsub/ /thub pa kho na'i bcas dbang 'dul ba'i lugs/ /lung rigs rlabs phreng phan bde'i lha ba can/ /rang blo ral bar 'chang ba'i thigs pa tsam/ /sa gsum rgud pa'i dri ma sel slad bsgrubs/ /ces pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /gnyis pa gos gzhi 'chad par/ mtshon gyis ma dras pa'i gos spyad par mi bya'o/ /dras shing drubs pa chos gos nyid du byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /sogs byung / 'de la gling gzhi/ spyi don/ mtha' dpyad gsum/ dang po yod de/ chos gos gsum tsam tshur shog dus nas yod la snam phran snrel zhi'i dras drub ni rgyal ṭo gzugs can snying pos 'tsho ba pa gos ngur smrig gyon pa la glang pho che las babs te/ phyag byas rkang par mgo 'os gtugs par/ 'khor gyis de ston pa'i nyan thos ma lags 'tsho ba pa lags smras pas/ rgyal yos ston par dge slong gi chos gos la gzhan dang mi 'khul pa'i mtshan ma mdzad par gsol bas/ lus 'phags kyi zhing lta bu'i dras drub byed par gnang ba'i phyid gnyis pa la gos kyi rgyu rung mi rung gi dang / gos so so'i rnam bzhag gi tshul dang / log 'tsho sogs spong tshul gyi dang / gos la longs rgyud par gnang ba'i rnam bzhag dang bzhi las/ dang po la mi rung ba'i de yod de/ ma dras pa'i kha tshar phun tshar can dang rgyu dpag bsam shing las byung ba dang / rab la rnga bal las byas pa dang / kha dog rung bas kha ma bsgyur ba dang / khra 'o sogs dang / tshon chen gyis kha bsgyur ba/ mu stegs cha lugs su gtogs pa'i skra'i g.yang gzhi sogs mi rung ba'i phyig dang 4 grub ste/ rtsabar/ snam bu ma 537
'dul ba gzhi smad/byas pa dang gso ma ni mi rung ngo / /zhes sogs dang / ṭīkka las/ kha tshar dang phun tshar mtha' gcad du rung ba/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyig rtags gnyis pa grub ste/ de nyid las/ ra phyar dang rnga bal gyi snam bu dang mu stegs skya rgyal mtshan yang ngo / /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig gsum pa grub ste/ khra 4 mi rung ngo / /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ mi rung ba'i tshon chen brgyad yod de/ me tog phreng rgyud las/ rgya skyegs le brgan rtsidang btsod/ /rma shing rtsidang mthing shing mtshal/ /sirna ra dang gur gum lte/ /'de dag tshon chen brgyad du 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa'i pyid rung ba bdun te/ bal las byas pa dang rtswa sha na las byas pa dang / nyi 'og pa'i gos dang] ras gos dang / rtswa zar ma dang / rtswa go tam pa las byas pa dang / rtswa du gu las byas pa bdun rung ba'i phyir te/ me tog phreng rgyud las/ bal gos sha na nyi 'og dang / /ras gos dang ni zar ma dang / /go tam pa dang du gu la/ /chos gos rgyu ni rnam pa bdun/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig bal dang ras sogs spu che ba la chos gos rnam gsum mi rung lte/ rtsabar/ spru can chos gos gsum nyid du byin gyis brlab par mi bya'o/ /zhes byung / yang rung ba'ang yod de/ rin chen rlung ba las/ gos kyi rnam pa kha tshar phun tshar ma bcad pa la yang gzhan med na byin gyis brlab pa chags so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i nyid lha ba dang be'u phrug spu chad pa dang phying ba sogs la chos gos dras drub mi rung yang lhan thabs rung ste/ lung gzhi las/ dge slong dag lnga 4 'di dag ni mi dra ba dag yin te/ sgying ba thams cad dang / wā ba thams cad dngad pe'u phrug thams cad dngad gram thams cad dang / gos seng ba thams cad de lhan thabs su glan te bcang bar bya'o/ /gling gzhi ni mnyan yod na'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de dag gi don yang yod de/ rnam bshad rin chen phreng ba las/phying ba dang lha ba bal las byas pa spru can dang ze'u phrug spu can te/ gram wā ba 'thug po dang seng ba gos phra mo ste/ de dag mi dra bar lhan thabs glan cing drub 'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ kha 538
81sa kyi gzhi/dog rung ba gsum gang rung gis kha bsgyur dgos te/ sa ga lhas/ sngon 4 btsag dang ngur smrig ṅga /'di dag rung ba'i tshon gsum lte/ /tshon gzhan dag gis chos gos ni/ /kha bsgyur byed pa bkag pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig 'di la dbyad bya mang yang mtha' dpyod du 'chad do/ /gnyis pa gos so so la 'tsho ba'i dang / lhag pa'i dang / mkho ba'i gos gsum/ dang 4 la mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ so so'i tshad dang sgrub tshul dang/ byin rlabs kyi cho ga/dgos bcang gi khyad par dang / byin rlabs la)ga pa'i rgyu drug dang po yod de/ rung ba tshad ldan re re bar gnang ba'i yo byad rang ming gis rlabs pa de de yin pa'i phyid gnyis pa dbye na bcu gsum yod de/ rtsabagsnam sbyar dang] bla gos dang] mthang gos dang] sham thabs dang/sham thabs kyi gzanadang] rngul gzan dang / rngul gzan gyi gzan dang / gdong phyis dang / rnag gzan dang / g.yan pa dgab pa dang] skra bzedadang gding ba dang] dbyar gyi gos ras chen dag bcang bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa tshad la lnga sa 8stos gsum gyi dang / lhag ma'i tshad gnyis/ lngastos bo sa gsum gyi tshad yod de/ byin gyis brlab tu rung gi snam sbyar bla gos mthang gos gsum/ che tshad srid du khu lnga zheng du khra gsum/ de gsum gyi chung tshad de'i srid zheng gnyis spur khra phyed phyed nd+ra ba dang]de gsum gyi 'bring tshad de gnyis kyi bar gang zhig/mthang gos srid du khra lnga 'am bzhi dang / zheng du khu do dang mi yogs na ral kha dpung chad bya ba dang chung ngu rgyab nas g.yogs pas bus mo gnyis sto ba gsum khebs pa yang yin pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ rtsabar/ byin gyis brlab tu rung ba chen po dag ni rang gi khu gsum dang lnga dag go/chung ngu dag ni gnyis ka las phyed phyed phri ba'o/ /'bring rnams kyi tshad ni bar ma'o/ /zhes 〈sna/ /gnyis pa grub lte/ rtsabag mthang bstos ni do dang lnga yang yin la/ do dang bzhi yang yin no/ /mi yogs na ral kha dpung chad bya'o/ /gshor gsum khebs pa nyid yan chad kyang cad /zhes gsungs pa'i phyid snam sbyar la snam phran dang tshal 539
'dulab gzhi smad/bu'i sgos dbye na dgu yod do/ /ga ngu skor gsum dang / 'bring skor gsum dang / chen po skor gsum rnams yod pa'i phyir te/ rtsabad snam sbyar gyi snam phran dag ni dgu yan chad nyi shu rtsalnga man chad de zung ma gtogs so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyid chung ngu gsum gyi snam phran dang glegs bu'i grangs yod de/ snam phran dgu pa bcu gcig pa bcu gsum pa gsum du bya zhing] de gsum ga'i snam phran re re yang glegs bu phyed dang gsum par byed pa'i phyir ste/ bam lnga las/ dang po gsum pa zhes bya ba ni/ snam sbyar rnam pa dgu las gsum pa dang po la ste/ snam phran dgu pa dang bcu gcig pa dang bcu gsum pa dag la'o/ /de dag gi glegs bu phyed dang gsum pa nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'bring gsum gyi snam phran dang glegs bu'i grangs yod de/ snam phran bco lnga pa dang bcu bdun pa dang bcu dgu pa gsum yod cing / de gsum lnga'i snam phran re relang glegs bu phyed dang bzhi bar byed pa'i phyir te/ bam lnga las/ gnyis pa la ni glegs bu phyed dang bzhi pa nyid do zhes bya ba ni snam sbyar gsum pa gnyis pa la ste/ snam phran bco lnga pa dang bcu bdun pa dang bcu dgu pa dag la'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ chen 4 gsum gyi snam phran dang gligs bu'i grangs yod de/ snam phran nyer gcig dang nyer gsum dang nyer lnga byed cing / de gsum lnga'i snam phran re re'ang glegs bu phyed dang lnga pa byed pa'i phyir te/ bam lnga las/ gsum pa la ni glegs bu phyed dang lnga pa nyid do/ /zhes bya ba ni snam sbyar gsum pa gsum pa la ste/ snam phran nyi shu gcig pa dang nyi shu gsum pa dang nyi shu lnga pa dag la'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyis bla gos chung 'bring che gsum gyi snam phran dang glegs bu'i grangs yod de/ gsum ka snam phran bdun pa dang snam phran re re'ang glegs bu phyed dang gsum par byed pa'i phyir te/ bam lngas bla gos ni snam phran bdun dang glegs bu phyed dang gsum pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ mthang gos gsum gyi snam phran dang glegs bu'i grangs yod de/ gsum ka snam phran lnga pa dang snam phran re re'ang glegs bu phyed dang 540
gos kyi bstun/gnyis par byed pa'i phyir te/ bam lngas mthang gos ni snam phran lnga dang glegs bu phyed dang gnyis pa'o/ /zhes zug/ /chos gos gsum dras drub byed tshul la gsum las/ dang 4 snam sbyar la yang dra ba dang drub tshul gnyis/ dang 4 ni/ snam sbyar gyi byed tshul yod de/ snam sbyar chen po gsum gyi dang yo la glegs bu phyed pa nyer lnga glegs bu tshang ma'am dkyil 'khor nyer lnga pa bzhi 'am brgyar dra ba dang] chen po'i 'bring la phyed pa nyer gsum dang glegs bu tshang ma nyer gsum pa bzhi 'am dgu bcu go gnyis su dra ba dang / chen po'i chung ngu la phyed pa nyer gcig dang glegs bu tshang ma nyer gcig pa bzhi'am brgyad cu gya bzhi dras la phyed pa dang phyed pa mnyam pa dang glegs bu dang glegs bu mnyam par dra ba de yin pa'i phyir te/ rtsabs glegs shu dang glegs bu pyed dag mnyam par bya'o/ /zhes dang / bam lnga las/ glegs bu rnams kyang lo gas shig tu mnyam par ga glegs bu phyed rnams kyang logs shig tu mnyam par bya'o/ /zhes dang / rkarma sha taṃ las/ dra'o/ /bsdeb ṭo/ /zungs gdab 4/ /zhes dang / rtsabar/ yang drag shing drubs pa chos gos nyid du byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /zhes dang/ṭīkka las kyang/ glegs bur dras shing drubs pa zhes bya ba'i tha tshig go/zhes gsungs pa'i phyigades snam sbyar lhag ma'i dras drub kyi snam phran dang glegs bu'i grangs shes par sga snam sbyar la dras drub kyis ma khyab kyang dras drub dgos nges yin te/ dgos nges yin kyang rkyen dbang gis ma byung ba yod pa'i phyir/ dper na nad pa ma yin pa'i dge slong gis nges par dgung za mi rung yang de za ba yod pa bzhin yin pa'i phyis des na snam sbyar ma yin pa 'i bla gos dang mthang gos la dras drub nges pa med pa'i phyid rtsabag snam sbyar min pa dag la dras te byin gyis brlab par nges pa med do/ /zhes dang / lung ma mo las/ snam sbyar ni nges par dras te bya'o/ /bla gosadang mthang gos ni nges pa med do/ /zhes dang/ me tog phreng rgyud las kyang/ snam sbyar nges par dras te bcang / /gzhan dag ma nges gang gi phyir/ /'dod chung rang gi chos gos 541
'dul ba gzhi smad/kyis/ /las kyi skyo ba skyed phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig gnyis pa drub tshul yod de/ snam sbyar rab lta bu la glegs bu phyed dang lnga lnga sbyar la tshal bu bya spru non gyi tshul du 'thud pa ni snam phran yin la/ rab kyi rab la glegs bu phyed dang lnga sbyar ba'i snam phran nyer lnga 'byung / rab kyi 'bring la de yo'i nyer gsum dang rab kyi tha mar nyer gcig 'byung ba'i phyir/ der thal/ de ltar mthud pa'i rnam pa la snam phran dang tshal bu zhes bya la/ drag pa ma 'thud pa dang 'thud pa'i ling tshe so so ba dag la glegs bu dang / de'i che ba la slegs bu dang chung bar glegs bu phyed pa zhes bya rigs pa'i phyir/ dang 4 grub ste/ de la snam phran dang tshal bu dang glegs tshar zhes kyang bya ba'i phyir te/ ṭīkka las/ 'dir snam phran zhes bya ba'i sgra ni srid du btang ba'i tshal bu la bya'o/ /zhes dang/ bam lnga las/ 'dir snam phran zhes bya ba'i tshal bu la bya yi glegs bu dang glegs bu phyed la ni mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang / rnam 'byed 'grel ba las/ 'dir yang snam phran zhes bya ba ni gligs bu gnyis dang glegs bu phyed sbyar ba'i snam phran gyi mtshan nyid ni snam phran yin par shes par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig rtags gnyis pa dang gsum pa grub lte/ rnam 'byed 'grel ba las/ glegs bu phyed dang gsum pa zhes bya ba ni gang la dkyil gakhor phyed dang gsum yod pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na glegs bu phyed dang lnga sbyar ba'i snam phran gcig dbus byas la/ de'i g.yas g.yon du snam phran bcu gnyis bcu gnyis re sbyar la dbus ma'i glegs bu'i 'phro phyi ma phyi ma'i steng du zon par sbyar bar bya ste/ de ltar sbyar bas snam phran dbus ma'i glegs bu'i 'phro g.yas g.yon gyi steng du thon zhing g.yas kyi snam phran nam tshal ring bcu gnyis kyi 'phro g.yas dang g.yon gyi snam phran nam tshal ring bcu gnyis kyi 'phyo g.yon du phyogs pa'i bya spu non mjes pa zhig 'ong ba'i phyir te/ rtsabar/ dbus nas gzhan du glegs bu'i 'phro phyogs phyogs su lta ba nyid dang] zhes dang /ṭīkka las/ phyogs phyogs su zhes zlos bur byas te/542
81sa kyi gzhi/g.yas phyogs kyi glegs bu rnams kyi 'phro yang g.yas phyogs su pyi brgyud du lta la/ g.yon phyogs kyi glegs bu rnams kyi 'phro yang ga〈snan phyogs su pyi brgyud du lta'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ snam phran gyi glegs bu snyel zhir drubs tshul yod de/ snam phran dbus ma'i glegs bu phyed pa de'i g.yas g.yon du glegs bu tshang ma yod pa'i snam phran re sbyag de bzhin du snam phran phyed pa dang tshang ma bsnol pas sbyar bas 'grub pa'i phyir te/ rtsabag snam phran snyel zhi nyid dang/ zhes dang / ṭīkka las/ snrel zhi zhes bya ba ni snam phran de dag gi tshal bu rnams kyi sna drang thad du ma babs par mtho dman mi mnyam pa nyid kyis 'grus thabs su 'dug pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyid gron gyi bya 'dul dang sa paṇa dang rje rin bo che sogs kyi chos gos bya spu non de ltar yin gyi tshal bu'i kha yas mar mi mthun pa min zhes bla ma mkhas pa mang sos gsung ngo / /snam phran sbyar ba de'i mtha' skor du zheng che chung mnyam pas skor ba dras drub la zur du dgos te/ rtsabadmtha' skor ba nyid dag gis 〈sna/ /zhes dang / ṭīkka las/ mtha' skor ba nyid ces bya ba ni mtha' thams cad bskor ba ste/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de mdzes pa'i ched yin te/ gos gzhi'i lung las/ des snam bu rnams kha phyogs gnyis nar bsnyan no/ /'on kyang mtha' skor med pas mdzes par ma gyur nas mtha' skor byas so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyid mtha' skor gyi zhing tshad 'grel chung las sor bzhir bshad/ tshal bu'i zheng tshad che 'bring chung gsum yod de/ snam phran nang ma nang ma phyi ma phyi mar spyar snam phran nang mi'i 'phyo sor bzhi sogs ma sbyar bar steng du thon pa de dang glegs bu so sor la' ltar thon pa de la tshal bu zeg de'i che tshad sor bzhidang] chung tshad phyed dang gsum mam gnyis dang mtheb sor gcig yin/ de'i bar 'tsheng tshad du lasdog pa'i phyisdang po grub ste/ snam phran dang glegs bu'i tshal bu thams cad chags shing gis tshad mnyam par byed dgos pa'i phyir te/ rtsabar/ tshal bu dag kyang ngo / /de'i tshad kyi chags shing bcang bar 543
'dul ba gzhismad/bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig gnyis pa grub ste/ rtsabad de'i che tshad ni sor bzhi'o/ /bya rog gi mtho gang yang ngo / /zhes gsungs pa'i phyis khyab ste/ 'di gnyis tshad lajal byed so sor bshad pa tsam yin pa'i phyir te/ṭīkka las/ de ltar bzhag pa'i mtheb mdzub gnyis kyi rtsemo'i bar gyi tshad ni bya rog gi mtho gang zhes bya'o/ /de la dngos su ni sor bzhi kho nawend de/ rnam pa gzhan gyis bstan pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyid gsum pa grub ste/ rtsabar/ chung tshad ni sor gnyis sam phyed dang gsum mam mtheb 〈snar gcig bosna/zhes dang / bam lnga las/ chung tshad ni sor gsum mam phyed dang gsum mam mtheb sor gcig go/zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang]ṭīkka las kyang ngo / /bzhi pa grub ste/ bam lnga las/ 'bring tshad ni de gnyis kyi bar ma'o zhes bya ba dag ni tshal bu'i zheng tshadade/de ni gos kyi gzhi phran tshegs la sogs pa'i skabs nas byunga'od /zhes gsungs pa'i sgyig de yang lung las/ chung 'bring tshad bshad tshul gnyis snang ngo] /des snam sbyar lhag ma rtogs par bya'o/ /snam sbyar la yang lhan thabs yang yod de/ chos gos gsum ga'i rgyu'i byin rlabs sngags las yang na 'di la lhan thabs su glan no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyab lte/gzhi 'grel las/ yang na 'di la lhan thabs su glan no/ /zhes bya ba ni chos gos ma dras pa'i steng du gzhan gyi snam phran dang glegs bu dang/ glegs bu phyed kyis lhan thabs su glan par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyis lhan thabs spyor tshul yang shin tu gsal lo/ /bla gos dang mthang gos kyi tshad dang dras drub byed tshul yod de/ byin gyis brlab rung de gnyis che tshad zheng du khra gsum dang mchur khra lnga dang chung tshad zheng du khu phyed dang gsum dang mchur khra phyed dang lnga yin la de'i bar 'bring tshad yin pa'i phyir te/ lung las/ byin gyis brlab tu rung ba chen 4 dag ni rang gi khra gsum dang lnga dag go/zhes dang / bam lnga las kyang / snam sbyar dang bla gos dang mthang gos byin gyis brlab tu rung ba chen yodag ni tshad gcig lte/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyiradang]ṭīkka dang/ gzhi 544
zugs kyi gzhi/'grel kun mthun pas skyogs bshad mi bya'o/ /bla gos kyi mtha' skor ma gtogs lhag ma glegs bu tshang ma bcu bzhi byed pa bdun dang /nyer gcig tu dras shing] glegs bu phyed dang gsum pa bya spru non du sbyar ba'i snam phran bdun gyi gcig dbus de'i blor glegs bu'i 'phro g.yas su lta ba'i snam phran gsum dang g.yon du glegs bu'i 'phyo g.yon du lta ba'i snam phran gsum sbyar te kun gyi mtha' lcags ris skor ba yin te/ bla gos la tshad gsum yod kyang snam phran bdun pa dang /glegs bu phyed dang gsum pa kho nar byin rlabs sngags las bshad pa ma gtogs ma gsungs pa'i phyir te/ bam lnga las/ bla gos ni snam phran bdun dang/ glegs bu phyed dang gsum pa'o/ /zhes dang / de byin rlabs sngags las snam phran bdun par bgyi ste glegs bu phyed dang gsum par bgyi'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyid mthang gos kyi tshad gzhan yang yod de/ zheng du khra do dang mchur khu lnga dang zheng du khra do mchur khra bzhi yang rung zhing dngor gsum khebs pa yang yod pa'i phyir te/rtsabag mthang gos ni do dang lnga yang yin la/ do dang bzhi yang yin no/ /lubor gsum khebs pa nyid yan chad kyang ngo) /zhes gsungs pa'i pyir/ khyab ste/ yang sgra snga mas byin gyis brlab rung gi mthang gos gsum du ma zad pa yang bshad la/ yang sgra pyi ma gnyis kyis snga ma snga mar ma zad 'di yang rung bar bshad/ dras drub byed tshul yod de/ lcags ri ma gtogs pa'i tshad de glegs bu tshang ma lnga dang / glegs bu phyed pa lnga te bcur dras shing] glegs bu che chung gnyis 'thud pas snam phran lnga dang / glegs rba phyed dang gnyis pa 'byung ba'i tshul du sbyar zhing / mtha' lcags ris skor ba de yin pa'i phyir te/ mthang gos kyi tshad gsum sogs yod kyang snam phran dang1 glegs bu lugs gcig las med pa'i phyir te/ lung gzhi las/ snam phran lngar bgyi lte/ glegs bu phyed dang gnyis par bgyi'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyis khyab ste/ bla gosadang mthang gos gnyis kyi snam phran byin rlabs kyi sngags las gzhan du gsal bar ma gsungs pa'i phyir te/ gzhi 'grel las/545
'dul bgazhi smad/de gnyis kyi gos spyan gyis brlab pa'i sngags de 'di las shes par bya yi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ bla gos dang mthang gos gnyis kyi snam phran gyi tshad ni snam sbyar gyi tshad ltar gang du'ang bka' ma stsal to/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ mthang gos kyis lus mi yogs na ral kha dpung chad bya zhing mtha' gcig tu ma nges te/ rtsabad mi yogs na ral kha dpung chad bya'o/ /zhes dang]bam lnga las/ gang gi lus che ches pas mthang gos kyi tshad de tsam gyis mi asnags na ral kha dpung chad bya lte/ khebs par yogs par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig las chog chen mor ral kha dpung chad ni tshad la nges bzung che ba med kyang mthang sham gyi phyed las che ba mi rung ba 'dra zhing / mtsho ṭīka las/ ral kha dpung chad ni rgya khyon ji tsam yod pa logs su byin gyis brlab ste sgro gu 'am gzungs kyis 'thud pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyis 'di dag la zhib cha cung dgos par mngon no/ /sgra bshad yod de/ tshog don dam pa'i dge gyong dang mya ngan las 'das pa dang mthun pa'i gos yin la khyim pa mu stegs sogs dang ma yin pas chos gos dang snam phran dang glegs bu du ma so sor ram kun tu sbyar bas na snam sbyar dang/ bla ste stod dam gong du gyon pa'i gos yin pas na bla gos/ mthang lte smad dam nang du gyon pa'i gos yin pas na mthang gos zhes brjod pa'i phyir/ rtags zur dang 4 grub ste/ mdo las/ khyim bdag gzhan dang / zhes pa nas/ 'di dag ni nye bar zhi ba dang mthun pa yin gyi/ 'di dag nyon mongs 'bar ba dang mthun pa min pa dang / ngur smrig 'di dag gis dkris shing g.yogs na sdig pa las ldog par bya ba dang / /sogs ltar yin pa'i phyig phyi ma gsum ṭīkka las bshad do/ /gnyis pa 'tsho ba'i yo byad lhag ma'i tshad dang] spyod tshul yod de/ sham thabs ni nyin mo mthang gos kyi 'og tu gyon pa dang]sham thabs kyi gzan ni mtshan mo mthang gos kyi 'og tu gyon pa dang tshad mthang gos dang 'dra/rngul gzanani nyin mo stod du gyon bdang] rngul gzan gyi gzan mtshan mo stod la gyon pade gnyis 546
81sa kyi gzhi/tshad bla gos dang 'dra la/ ma dras pa'i stod g.yogs che ba srid du khra bcu gnyis zheng du khra gsum dang] chung tshad bla gos lta bu dang] ma dras pa'i smad g.yogs kyi che tshad srid du khra bdun dang zheng du khra do dang chung tshad mthang gos ltar yin la/ de gnyis khyim pa'i stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs zhes bya zhing 'bring tshad mi 'ong ba'i phyir/ dang po bzhi yang grub lte/ me tog phreng rgyud las/ rngul gzan mthang gos med par ni/ /chos gos chen so longs mi spyad/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyig lnga pa dang drug pa grub ste/ sa ga lhas/ khra ni bcu gnyis stod g.yogs gsum/ /smad g.yogs kyang ni bdunadang gnyis/ /re zhig 'de ni 'dzig rten pa'i/ /stod g.yogs smad g.yogs zhes su gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig khyab ste/ des stod ga〈snags smad ga'adzigs ma dras pa che tshad dang tha snyad bstan cing / chung tshad 'chad par sa ga lhas/ khu ni lnga gsum snam sbyar te/ /gnyis rim stod g.yogs dag kyang ngo / /khya ni lngadang gnyis podag/re zhig bstan pa'i smad ga〈snags sesna/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig ji skad du/ rje 'dul 'dzin gyi gzhi gsum tsho ga las/ma dras pa'i stod g.yerdzogs/ zhes pa nas/ ma dras pa'i stod g.yogs smad ga〈snags gnyis la 'bring tshad ni med do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyid gzhan yang 'tsho ba'ide yod de/ gdong phyis ni gdong lag phyi ba rung bas kha bsgyur ba tshad khru gang srid zheng du ldan pa dang / rnag gzan ni dge slong rnag nad can gyis sha la sbyar nta/ bgo ba'i gos ci tsam gyis chog pa dang] g.yan pa dgab pa ni g.yan pa'i nad can gyis sha la sbyar te/ bgo ba'i gos yin la tshad srid du khu drug zheng du khra gsum yin/ skra bzed ni skra bregs pa'i tshe gyon pa'i gos yin la srid du khra gsum zheng du phyed dang gnyis yod pa dang / gding ba ni gnas mal bskyab pa'i ched du gnang ba tshad srid du khu gsum zheng du khra do dang sor drug yin la des mi chog na srid du khra phyed dang do skyed pa dang /dbyar gyi gos ras chen ni char skyabs pa'i ched du kyon pa yin la/ tshad srid du khra dgu zheng du 547
'dul ba gzhi smad/khra gsum dang sor bco brgyad yod pa dang / de dag thams cad rung ba'i tshon gyis kha bsgyur dgos pa'i phyid dang 4 grub ste/ rtsabad gdong phyis bcang bar bya'o/ /zhes dang / sa ga lhas/gdongadang lag pa pyi ba lte/ zhes so/ /gnyis pa grub ste/ rtsabag lus rnag 'dzag pas rnag gzan no/ /de chos gos kyi nang du babocasna/ /sesnags byung] gsum pa grub ste/ rtsabar/ g.yan pa dgab pa'i 'o/ khu drug dang gsum mo/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyid bzhi pa grub lte/ phreng rgyud las/ srung pa'i don du skra bzed ni/ /zheng du khra ni pyed dang gnyis/ /srid du khra ni gsum yin te/ /lhag par rtag par mi bya'o/ /zhes sem/ /lnga pa grub ste/ rtsabad gding ba'i'o/ /'di'i tshad ni srid du khu gsum mo/ /mi chog na khra phyed dang do man chad skyed do/ /ṇḍa'i zheng du ni khra do dang sor drug go/zhes gsungs pa'i pyid drug pa grub ste/ rtsabad dbyar gyi ras chen gyi'o/ /dgu dang gsum dang sor bco brgyad do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig bdun pa grub ste/ rung bas kha ma bsgyur ba lhung bzed kyi kha g.yogs tsam yang bcang na ltang ba 'byung ba'i phyir te/ rtsabag sngon po 'am dmar po'am ngur smrig gis kha ma bsgyur ba rang gi gos tha na lhung bzed kyi kha g.yogs snod dang rkang pa'i 'a4ba dang ska rags dag gi bsgo ba la sogs pa la yongs su longs sbyod na'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig gar gos sogs kha ma bsgyur ba shin tu mi rung ngo) /des na 'tsho ba'i yo byad la gnyis yod de/ dngos sngar bshad bcu gsum dang / 'tsho ba'i yo byad phran tshegs zhwa ska rags lham lhung bzed kyi shubs kha g.yogs ram phyis sam phor phyis rnams yin pa'i phyig 'jal byed kyi khru yang 'dul bar gsum bshad de/ rdul khu dang lus khra lag khu gsum yod cing des gzhal pa'i sgo nas bzhag pa'i sgyid dang po yod de/ rtsabag rdul phra rab dngaka rdul phra mo dngaka chu dang lcags dang] ri 'ong dang / lug dang glang dang/ nyi zer gyi rdul dang / sro ma dang shig dang / nas dang sor rnams ni snga ma drug las phyi ma'o/ /sor bzhi drug la khra gang ngo / /khra phyed dang bzhi la 548
gos kyi gzhi/ni mi'i srid do/ /khra bzhi la gzhu'o/ /de lnga brgya la rgyang grags so/ /dgon pa'i dang 4 ni de'i mtha' 'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyis mdzod dang 'di'i drug rtsis dang bdun rtsis ni rags zhib dang chu lcags gong 'og gi rdul gnyis yang mi gcig par bya'o/ /gzhan sla/ gnyis pa yod de/gabag khra'i don ni lus kyi cha bdun las gnyis so/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ ṭīkka las/ khā ni gru mo nas gung po'i meemo'i bar ro/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa grub ste/ mtsho ṭīka las/ rdul khra lus khu lag khra ste/ /khya gsum rnam dbye shes par spha /rdul khras gzhal bar bya ba ni/ /khang pa'i tshad dang khri rkang tshad/ /gding ba g.yan dgab ras chen no/ /de dag las gzhan chos gos rnams/ /lus khu'am lag khras gzhal ba ste/ /lus ring ha cang lag thung dang / /de las ldog pa'i chos gos rnams/ /rang gi lus khra kho nas gzhal/ /lus tshad lag tshad 'tsham pa yis/ /lag khus kyang ni gzhal du rung] /zhes dred/ /bzhi pa byin rlabs kyi cho ga yod de/ yul dge slong khyad par bdun ldan gyi mdun du/phyag gam gus pas snyan gsan dang / de nas gos bltab pa rang gi phrag par bkal ba'i sne nas gnyis gas 'greng ste bzung nas/ btsun pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas chos gos bgyis lags pa rung ba spyad par 'os pa 'di chos gos snam sbyar du byin gyis brlab bo gsum brjod de/ thabs legs bya la/ de bzhin du 'tsho ba'i yo byad so sor brjes la byin rlabs bya zhing lhag pa rnam brtags kyi byin rlabs yang byed pa'i phyir te/ sa ga lhas/ rang dang tsho gas byin brlabs nas/ /de las gzhan rnams brtags nas te/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de dag byin rlabs kyi dgos pa yod de/ de byas pas 'chang langog gi ltang ba mi 'byung ba dngad byin rlabs kyi gos de med pa'i nyes pa khegs pa'i phyis snam sbyar sogs dngos med na rgyu'i byin rlabs la gzhan sngar ltar byas te/ btsun pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag 549
'dul ba gzhi smad/ming 'di zhes bgyi bas chos gos 'di snam sbyar du pyin gyis brlab 'o/ /'tshal la bar chad ma byung na snam phran dgu pa la sogs par bgyis te/ glegs bu phyed dang gsum pa la sogs par bgyi'o/ /bkru'o/ /bskyang ngo / /dra'o/ /bldeb 'o/ /gzung gdab 'o/ /drub 4/ /kha bsgyur ro/ /yang na 'di la lhan thabs su glan no/ /rkyen du ji lta ba bzhin du bgyi lte/ chos gos 'di ni rung ba spyad par 'os pa'o/ /zhes pa de yin la thabs legs kyang ngo / /bla gos la snam phran bdun pa dang] glegs bu phyed dang gsum pa zhes dang / chos gos bla gos su byin gyis brlab bo/ /zhes dang / mthang gos la mthang gos su byin gyis brlab ṭo/ /zhes dang / snam phran lnga pa dang / glegs bu phyed dang gnyis par bya'o/ /zhes bya'o/ /yul med na shā ri'i bu mdun du dmigs la lha dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di sogs bya/ /de bzhin du lhag pa'i yo byad dang mkho ba'i yo byad kyi sngags bsgyur sla'o/ /lnga pa dgos bcang gi sems kyi khyad par yod de/sbyor 'du shes lnga dang / khyad par du lus la rma dang ngo tsha ba'i gnas dang gos la rma dkris dang ngo tsha sgrib byed dang 'tsho ba'i yo byad kyi byin rlabs dang dge skyong gis dran pa gso ba sogs dran pa dang / 'tsho ba'i yo byad rang gi yin pa'i bsam pas dang / lhag pa'i yo byad gzhan gyi yin bsam pas dang / mkho ba'i yo byad rang gzhan thun mong du dbang ba'i sems kyis 'chang ba'i phyir/ drug pa byin rlabs 'jig rgyu bzhi yod de/ sngags kyis dang / rten zhing ma yin pas dang / gos zhing ma yin pas dang / gzhan la byin pas 'jig pa sogs yod pa'i phyir/ lhag pa'i yo byad kyi gos la'ang gnyis yod de/ dngos ni snam sbyar sogs bcu gsum gang rung lhag pa lta bu dang lhag pa'i gos phran tshegs zhwa dang ska rags lhag pa lta bu yin pa'i phyig 'di med mi rung min yang skyid bde ba las rab tu byung ba dang shig dang sro ma mang ba dang / rdul dang dri ma mang ba rnams kyis rnam brtags byas nas 'chang ba'i phyig mkho ba'i yo byad la'ang dngos dang 550
gos kyi gzhi/phran tshegs gnyis yod de/ dang poni/ 'tsho lhag gnyis gang rung ma yin pa'i ras yug dar yug gos yug sogs dang / ring 'gag dang bem 4 sogs dang] gos su nges pa med pa khra gang du longs pa thams cad dang / gnyis pa phran tshegs ni/ ras kha phyed dang dar kha phyed sogs yin pa'i phyir/ de yang bla gos gsum yod na gcig 'tsho ba'i dang / gcig lhag pa'i dang / gcig mkho ba'i yo byad du brlab dgos/ byin rlabs kyi tsho ga gzhi gsum cho ga ltar bya'o/ /gsum pa rgyu'i sgo nas log 'tsho lnga spang dgos te/ tshul 'chos dang / kha gsag dang /gzhogs slong dang / thob kyis 'jal dang / rnyed pas rnyed pa 'tshol ba lnga smad pa'i phyir te/ rin chen phreng ba las/ tshul 'chos rnyed dang bkur nyi'i phyir/ /dbang po sdom par byed pa ste/ /kha gsag rnyed dang bkur nyi'i phyir/ /tshig 'jam snyan par smra ba'o/ /gzhogs slong de ni thob bya'i phyig /gzhan gyi rdzas la bsngags byed pa/ /thob kyis 'jal ba rnyed pa'i phyis /mngon sum gzhan la smod byed pa/ /rjed pas rnyed pa rnams 'dod pa/ /sngar thob pa la bsngags byed pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa longs spyod par gnang tshul yod de/ snam sbyar gyon dus brgyad sogs dang / sham thabs gyon nas thams cad rung ba dang / dge slong gis mi na par gos re re bas zas la spyad mi rung ba yin pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ sa ga lhas/ snam sbyar dge slong 'dus pa dang / /zas dang mchod rten phyag byed dang / /grong sogs 'jug la bgo bya yi/ /gzhan dag tu ni dgag pa mdzad/ /ces sem/ /gnyis pa grub ste/ /sa ga lhas/ lnga pa sham thabs lus rtsu1na nas/ /bya ba mtha' dag byed par rung / /zhes sdud/ /gsum pa grub ste/ sa ga lhas/ zas la nad pa ma gtogs par/ /bosnas gcig pa ni bkag pa yin/ /zhes sdud/ /bo(sa semags la 'dzings spyodad par gnang tshul lnga yod de/ mi slob pa bdag po'i tshul gyis rgyud/ 'phags pa slob pa byin pa len pa'i dang] tshul khrims dag cing thos sogs la brtson pa gnang pa'i dang/ tshul khrims ldan 551
'dul ba gzhi smad/yang le lo can sogs kyis bu lon gyis dang/ tshul khrims 'chal bas lcags gong dmar 'bar la longs spyod pa'i tshul gyis dgos pa'i phyig dang 4 gsum grub ste/ dge tshul gyi lo 3 las/mi slob pa ni bdag sor bshad/ /slob pa pyin pa len pa yin/ /bsam gtan 'don dang ldan pa ni/ /rjes su gnang rnams dka' thub can/ /zhes dang/ rtsabad mya ngan las 'das pa'i bsam pas rab tu byung ba tshul khrims dang ldan pa rnams la ni gos darṣa pa ṇa stong phrag brgya ri ba dang /zas ro brgya pa dang/ khang pa brtsegs pa lnga brgya pa yang 'os so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyig bzhi pa grub ste/ rtsabs le lo can la ni blangs pa dang nye bar spyad pa bu lon du 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang]ṭīkka las/ tshe rabs gzhan la sbyin bdag de la dbya 'jal lam de'i bran g.yog dang phyugs la sogs par skye bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes bya ba'i tha tshig go/zhes gsungs ba'i phyir dang] lung las zhing pa lnga brgya dang rmon grang lnga brgyar skyes par gsungs pa'i gtam rgyud ltar ro/ /lnga pa grub ste/rtsabar/ tshul khrims 'chal ba la ni ma yin no/ /zhes dang / lung rnam 'byed las/ lcags gong me lce 'bar ba dag /zos par gyur pa mchog yin gyi/ /tshul 'chal yang dag mi sdom pas/ /yul gagor badrend snyoms za ba min/ /zhes dang / dkon brtsegs las/ 'chal ba'i tshul khrims can dag gis/ /chos gos rab tu gyon gyur kyang] /dad pas sbyin pa chud zos pas/ /thu lum 'bar ba mid pa 'dra/ /zhes dang / lung gling gzhi las/ tshul khrims nyams pa nidage 'dun gyi kun dga' ra bar rkang pa'i nying pa tsam yang yongs su longs spyod par ma gnang ngo / /zhes gsungs pa'i phyisde lta na yang tshul 'chal yang mu stegs lasazungan gnas su lhag cing tshul khyims ldan pas longs spyod kyi bar du sbyin bdag gi bsod nams rab tu 'phel ba'i phyir te/ me tog phreng rgyud las/tshul ldan ji srid legs par ni/ /chos gos la sogs longs sbyordzod pa/ /de srid rgyun mi 'chad par ni/ /sbyin bdag rnams kyi bsod nams 'phel/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ lung mang ngo / /552
shegs kyi bstoni/mtha' dpyad pa la kha bya/ cig na re/ chos gos gsum tshad las lhag pa la chos gos gang rung gi dngos kyi byin rlabs chags pa med zeg yang la la sung] na re/ chos gos gsum gang rung dngos kyi byin gyis brlab rung dang gyon rung don gcig par bsams nas chos gos gsum tshad gcig par bshad pa byed do/ /dang 4 mi 'thad par thal/ spyir de'i dngos kyi byin rlabs mi chags kyang / dmigs bsal chags pa yang yod pa'i phyir/ dang po grub lte/ ṭīkka las/ gos ji lta bu la dang tshad ci tsam la byin rlabs chags par 'gyur ba dang / de las ldog pa la spang bar 'gyur ba de bshad par bya lte/ zhes dang / ṭīkka las/ gos tshad las lhag pa ni spang bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub lte/ sra brkyang lta bu la tshad las lhag pa'i gos gsum dar byin rlabs chags pa'i phyir te/ rtsabar/ lnga pa'o/ /lhag pa yang ngo / /zhes gsungs pa'i pyid gnyis pa yang shin tu mi 'thad par thal/ spyan gyis brlab rung gi chos gos chen po gsum tshad gcig gang zhig de 'dra'i mthang gos chen po gyon mi rung ba'i phyis dang 4 grub ste/ de tshad gcig pa rtsab dang rgya 'grel du ma'i dgongs pa yin pa'i phyir te/rtsabar/ byin gyis brlab tu rung ba chen po dag ni khra gsum dang lnga dag go /zhes dang / de'i ṭīkka las/ snam sbyar dang bla gos mthang gos byin gyis brlab tu rung ba chen po dag ni tshad gcig lte/ zheng du khu gsum dang mchur lnga'o/ /zhes dang / gzhi 'grel las kyang / de dag gi tshad ji tsam zhe na/ snam sbyar dang / bla gos dang / mthang gos byin gyis brlab tu rung ba chen so dag ni tshad gcig ste/ zheng du khu gsum dang mchur khra lnga'o/ /zhes dang / bam 4 lnga bcu pa las/ de dag gi tshad ji lta bu zhe na/ de'i phyir byin gyis brlab tu rung ba chen ngo dag ni rang gi khu lnga dang gsum dag go /zhes bya ba gsungs te/ snam sbyar dang / bla gos dang / mthang gos byin gyis brlab tu rung ba chen po dag ni gcig ste/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ byin 553
'dul bgazhi smad/gyis brlab rung smos pa'i rnam bcad kyang yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub lte/ de 'dra'i mthang gos 'jol drag pas ltang ba 'ong ba'i phyir/ byas pa la kho na re/ de mi 'thad par thal/ rtsabadchen po dag ni zhes gnyis tshig byung ba'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ lung na mang po la'ang gcig tshig dang gnyis tshig byas pa du ma dang 'gyur gyi khyad yang yod pa'i phyir/ de ltar na/ rtsabar/ chung ngu dag ni zhes pa'ang snam sbyar dang / bla gos kho nar lhor bar thal lo/ /dag ni zhes gnyis tshig las ma byung ba'i phyig 'dod na/ ṭīkka las/ chos gos snam sbyar dang bla gos dang mthang gos chung ngu dag gi tshad ni/ zhes dang / bam lnga las/ chung ngu dag ni gnyis las khra phyed phyed phri ba'o/ /zhes bya ba ni chos gos snam sbyar dang / bla gos dang mthang gos chung ngu dag gi tshad ni zhes gsungs pa re re nas mi 'thad par thal lo/ /'dod na/ so sor thar pa'i mdo yang mi 'thad par thal/ de las de ltar byung ba'i phyir/ gshor gsum khas/ gzhan yang / rtsabar so thar las 'bring rnams kyi tshad ni bar ma'o zhes pa'ang chos gos snam sbyar dang] bla gos kho nar bhyor bar thal/ che chung la de'i phyig 'dod na/ bam lnga dang ṭīkka las/ de chos gos gsum la sbyar ba dang rnams sgra mi 'thad par thal/ 'dod pa'i pyid lha'or gsum khas/ gzhan yang ṭīkka las/ mthang gos kyi tshad kyi rnam pa gzhan bstan pa'i pyid mthang gos ni sogs dngaka bam lnga las kyang de ltar bshad pa'i don med par thal/ mthang gos la sngar bshad pa'i rnam pa gsum 4 der ma zad rnam pa gzhan 'ga' zhig yod pa bstan par sga zhes pa'i don ma yin pa'i sgyid ma grub na dngos su 'gal/ ma khyab na/ mthang gos kyi tshad/ rtsabag mthang gos ni do dang lnga yang yin la do dang bzhi yang yin no/ /gabor gsum khebs pa nyid ces bshad pa nyi tshe 'am kho nar thal/ des ma khyab pa de'i phyig 'dod na/ ṭīkka dang / bam lngas sngar bshad pa dang nyi tsher ma zad do/ /zhes pa dang 'gal lo/ /yang kha cig na re/ chos gos gsum rab dras drub dang 'bring lhan 554
gos kyi gzhi/thabs dang tha ma thang thang po 3ra ba mi 'thad par thal/ chos gos gsum la dras drub dang lhan thabs gang rung zhig dgos pa'i phyis der thal/ de gsum gyi rgyu'i byin rlabs kyi sngags las/'tshal la nas/ bkru'o/ /brkyang ngo / /dra'o/ /bsdeb bo/ /gzung gdab 4/ /drub 4/ /kha bsgyur ro/ /yang na 'di la lhan thabs su/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ 'dis gos bkru brkyang dra drub/ 'tshem bsdeb kha bsgyur tshun chad byas nas dra ba dang lhan thabs gnyis kyi tshal snam byed tshul ma gtogs byed tshul gzhan ma bshad pa'i phyir dang / de las gzhan lung na med par ṭīkka dag gis bshad pa'i phyir/ des na de 'dra bar dgongs nas/ las chog chen mo las/ 'dul 'dzin grags rgyal gyi bslab bya chen mor snam phran dang glegs bu med pa'i bla gos me long ma lta bu bzhed kyang de ni rab byung ma yin pa'i sngags par khas 'che ba laga' zhig gis chos gos su ming 'dogs pa yin pas lugs 'di ji ltar 'thad brtag par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/'di bkod pa'i dgongs pas kyang mi 'thad par shes so/ /yang kha cig /chos gos gang rung la dngos kyi byin rlabs can gyis khyab pa dang / 'tsho ba'i yo byad la'ang dngos kyi byin rlabs can dang re re bas khyab par 'dod pa'ang 'gal 'du yin par thal/ tshig don re re nas 'gal ba zhugs pa'i phyir/ der thal/ tshig gi 'gal ba lhag pa'i yo byad tshig dang chos gos sogs re re ba dang dngos kyi pyin rlabs can gyi tshig 'gal ba'i phyir/ der thal/ de lhag ma med pa'i phyir te/ re re ba dang dngos kyi byin rlabs gcig las mi chags pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ snga ma ma byung bar phyi ma mi chags pa dang 'gal lo/ /don la yang 'gal bar thal/ bla gos dras drub lhag pa de bla gos yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de bla gos kyi dngos por grub zin pa'i sgyig de'i sngags tshig las/ chos gos bgyis lags pa rung ba spyad par 'os pa zhes pa'i don grub pa'i phyir/ yang kha cig na re/ snam sbyar la glegs bu phyed dang lnga las lhag pa rung bar thal/ de la 555
'dul ba gzhi smad/glegs bu bdun pa dang dgu pa yang rung ba'i phyis der thal/ nyan 'os kyi sa las/ chos gos chen po'i dum bu bdun nam dum bu dgu pa gnyis sbyar du brtsegs pa gang yin pa de ni snam sbyar zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ ma khyab lte/ sde pa gzhan gyi lugs tsam yin pa'i phyir/rtsabar 'dod mi nus te/ snam phran re glegs bu phyed dang lnga las mang dra mi rung ba'i phyir/ rtsabar/ de yan chad ni tshem bu'o/ /zhes dang / gsum pa gsum la phyed dang lnga pa'o/ /zhes dang /ṭīkka rnam 'byed 'grel ba bam lnga las nyer lnga yan chad mi rung bar bshad pa'i phyir/ yang sngon dang phyi'i rang re'i kha cig /lhag pa'i yo byad kyi gos su byin gyis brlab rung la rung ba tshad ldan sngar byin brlabs ma yin pa dgos gsung / de la kha cig na re/ gos mi rung ba dang tshad dang mi ldan pa'i gos la'ang lhag pa'i yo byad kyi byin rlabs chags par thal/ so thar 'grel chen las/ dbyibs mi rung ba zlum po ste/ mkhan po la yid gtad de bcang bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ lung des gos mi rung ba rang gis sgrub mi rung zhing / sbyin bdag gis phul na dmigs bsal gyis mkhan po 'am sgyin bdag la yid gtad de bcang rung bar bshad tsam yin pa'i pyid des na lhag pa'i yo byad la sbyor rung ba dang tshad ldan dang sngar byin rlabs dang ma 'brel ba dgos kyang nges bzung ma yin byas na 'thad par sems te/sbyor chos gos kyi tshad las lhag par byin rlabs mi rung yang dmigs bsal rung ba du ma yod pa'i phyir te/ darma sha taṃ las/ gos rung ba ma bgyis pa 'di rung bar bgyid par 'os pa zhes gsungs pa yang mi 'gal ba'i phyir/ rnyed par dbang tshul sogs ṭīkka dang rin chen phreng bar bltas nas shes par gyis/556
ko lpags kyi gzhi gsum pa dmigs bsal dang 'brel ba ko lugs kyi gzhi 'chad pa la/ yul dbus dang mtha' 'khob kyi sa tshigs bshad pa dang / mchil lham gnang ma gnang gi sa mtshams dang / ko lpags rung mi rung gi sa mtshams/ chu klung brgal ba'i thabs bzhi/ dang po 'chad par/ yul dbus kyi mtshams so/ /zhes byung / 'di la sa tshigs kyi dbus dang / chos kyi dbus gnyis yod de/ dang pho ni/ rdo rje gdan dkyil du byas nas shar du liṃ kha ra'i shing tshing tshing can yod pa tshun chad dbus dang de phan chad mtha' gshob dang / lhor chu klung de ba zhes 'dam bu can yod pa tshun chad dbus dang de phan chad mtha' gsob dang / nub tu bram ze'i grong ka ba dang nye ba'i ka ba gnyis yod pa de tshun chad dbus dang de phan chad mtha' gshob/ byang na u shi ra'i ri yod pa tshun chad dbus dang phan chad mtha' 'khob yin pa'i phyir te/ lung ko lpags kyi gzhi las/ li kha ra tshing tshing zhes bya ba de ni dbus so/ /de phan chad mtha' lubob 4/ /zhes pa nas/ yu shi ra'i ri zhes bya ba yod de/ de ni dbus so/ /de phan chad ni mtha' 'khob 4/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ u shi ri rtswa dres ma ste/ dren thar 'grel ba las/ u shi ri zhes bya ba dres ma'i rtsaba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyid dgos pa lnga tshogs bcu tshogs pa'i khyad par dang / ko lpags sogs shes pa'i ched yin no/ /gnyis pa ni gang du dngor dge slong pha ma dge bsnyen pha ma ste gshor rnam bzhi rgyu ba dbus dang / mi rgyu ba mtha' gsob tu nyan sa sogs las bshad do/ /rdo rje gdan dang yul 'di bzhi'i bar dpag tshad bcu yod par lo chen mang pos 'dod kyang rang lugs bcu drug yod par bya ste/ ngal gso dang tsha lam gyi grangs kyis kyang shes la/ de ma byas na 'dzam gling gi tshad mi long ba'i phyir te/ 'dul lung las/ rdul phra rab bdun la rdul lo/ /rdul bdun la sro 557
'dulab gzhi smad/ma'o/ /dreng ma bdun la shig sgasna/shig bdun la nas dren/ /nas bdun la glengar tshigs dred/ /dregar tshigs bcu gnyis la mtho'o/ /mtho gnyis la khu'o/ /khu bzhi la gzhu 'dom mo/ /gzhu 'dom lnga la srog shing lnga1 /srog shing nyi shu la ngal bso'o/ /ngal brtso brgyad cu la rgyang grags so/ /gzhu 'dom stong phrag brgyad po de na gnas pa ni dgon pa chen po'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyis 'dul bar yang zhib tu na bdun rtsis kyang 'do ltar yang yod do/ /milugs mang ngo| /gnyis pa ston par mtha' lubob tu mchil lham bcang bar bya'o/ /zhes byung / sbyor btang la yul dbus su mchil lham bkag kyang mtha' 'khob tu gnang ba yin te/ rdo can gyi yul sa sogs nab par lham rim pa gcig pa dang] de zad na lhan pa dang/ sha za rung ba'i ko lpags kyi gdan rung bar ka tya nas 'phrin lnga la brten nas gnang ba'i phyig gleng 'bum dang lung gzhi las so/ /dmigs bsal la yul dbus su yang gnang ste/ gdan mi rung ba spang ba'i ched du gnang ba'i phyir te/ rtsabad gnas mal bskyab pa'i phyir yang ngo / /zhes serdzo/ /'o na mchil lham gzhan yang ci tsam 〈snad ce na du ma 〈snad de/ ko lpags kyi yu ba byas pa'i yu ring dngan mchil lham rim pa mang po can dngan sal ko ba can dang] sna dang nying ba'i sbubs canadang / yu ring sgro nyu can dang]yu bcad sogs gnang ba'i phyig der thal/ klu sog ma med kyis dug char phabs pasadage slong rnams kyi rkang par nas reg pas rma byung bas kha chu chus byung ngam mchil lham gnang] dge slong zhig la khyim bdag gis lham rim pa mang 4 can phul bar brten nas khyim pas 〈snam bdun sor phyin rung bar gnang/ kun dga' 'o bal yul du nye du ltar byon nas lhags pas zhabs la ser ka byung bar brten nas kha ba can du lham sgrog gu can yang gnang ba'i phyir te/ rim pa mang po can ni lham ngo rim pa mang 4 yin no/ /rtsabag chu la chab rom chags pa'i yul du zhwa dang lham sgrog gu can yang ngo] /zhes dang] sol ko ba can mi rung ba nyid ma yin no/ /sna dang ltang pa'i sbrubs can 558
ko lpags kyi'atshon/bcang bar gnang rga /kha chu chus byung ngo] /lham yu chad kyang rga /zhes gsungs pa'i phyog yu ba can dang yu zung gi khyad par yod de/ rkang mthil las pus mor sleb pa yu ring dngaka rkang mthil nas rje ngar sgya phyed du sleb pa yu thung yin pa'i mig der thal/ phran tshegs kyi ṭīkka las/ yu ring ni rkang pa'i mthil nas pus mo zug pa'i lham yin no/ /yu thung ni rje ngar gyi phyed khyab pa'i lham yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyid mchil lham zhes pa sbyo ming bye brag la thogs pasan te/ 〈snag ma med pa'i mchil ma'i dug gam yang na dug sprul gyi dug skyob pa'i phyir gnang bsan kha chu chus byung ngam mchil lham zhes brjod pa yin pa'i pyid gling 'bum serdzogs las rtso/ /gsum pa 'chad pag khyim gzhan du gzhan med na ko lpags la 'dug par bya'o/ /zhes pa nas/ sha la sesnags pa yang ngo] /zhes byung / sgyir rab byung sde lnga sprus ko lpags spyad mi rung mtha' na'ob dag tu spyad rung lte/ mtha' dgob tu ko lpags kyi gdan la 'dug nyal sesnags rung la dmigs kyis bsal na/ yuladabus su stan gzhan medan 'dug rung bdang/ rlungand migand gzhanayangand can la dom lpags bcang ba dang gtsug lag khang gi sgo sogs su bting rung ba'i phyir te/ rtsabad khyim gzhan du/ nas/ rlung nad can gyis ni 'dug pa dang nyal bar yang bya'o/ /sogs byung / des na sha mi rung ba dag gi ko ba dang rus pa sogs mi rung ba yin pa'i phyir te/ rtsabad gang gi go lpags mi rung ba nyid yin pa de'i rus pa dang so dang sha la sogs pa yang ngo / /zhes gsungs pa'i sgyigbzhi pa 'chad pas rtsabar/ rkyal ba bska ba can bcang bar bya'o/ /glegags byung / chu klung bzod tshul yod de/ dben par rkyal bslab pas dang chu gting zab na ba glang dman pa'i rnga ma la brten nas bgrod mi rung khyu mtshog gi rnga ma la brten nas bzod par byed pa'i phyig559
'dul ba gzhi smad/smras pa/dul dul dgra bcom 'phags pa'i tshogs kyi gos/ /legs legs dras nas sgru1na tshe lha dang klus/ /yang yang dga' bas bltas te skye rgu la/ /skyid skyed dga' ston shub pa'i gsung bzhin byed/ /mang mang dus ring 'og ma mi snang nas/ /dam dam sgo gsum ma bsnams nyes nyungad snam/ /༵༵/nypha/ sna /(pa shāshā sbyo/ ñdzarsha kṣiṃ ༷ji spri/rgya/ji ༵ /nga/dī sdi/ rdzu sdu dzā/ )pa spra/lha bshad pas/ /'phags mchog nye bar 'khor ram nyer sbas sam/ /yon shāka gang yin gzhan du drenam nyi ci/ /zhes pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /560
sman gyi gzhi/gnyis pa bde bar gnas pa'i rkyen sman gzhi 'chad par/ /sman bsten par bya'o/ /de ni rnam pa bzhi'o/ /dus su rung ba dang / thun tshod du rung ba dang / zhag bdun pa dang / 'tsho ba'i bar du bcang ba nyid do/ /zhes sogs byung / 'di la sbyi'i don dang / mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/ /dang po la/ gleng gzhi/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ so so'i ngo 4 dang / byin gyis brlab tshul/ de longs rgyud pa'i gnas rung khang gcod tshul/ rgyu mthun zag pa 'dor tshul dang bdun/ dang po yod de/ ston pa rgyal byed tshal na bzhugs pa'i tshe dge slong rnams ston lnga'i nad kyis thebs pas skya 4 seng seng por gyur pa ston pas mkhyen bzhin du kun dga' bo la rgyu dris pas de ltar zhus pa na dge slong rnams kyis sman rnam pa serdzo sesnar bsten par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs nas bslab pa 'di bcas pa'i phyir rjes bcas du ma yod/ gnyis pa yod de/ 'dod khams pa'i 'tsho ba'i rten byed pa'i dri rṇi sbri pasum: pache jilhasu phru ༵ rdzu /sna rsha kau dzño dīlha ༵ ༵/ pas (( lhang/ /khapa ñdzashā ༵ hūm̐ bsten par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa dbye na bzhi 'dzid de/ dus rung gi dang /thun tshod du rung ba'i dang / zhag bdun pa'i dang / 'tsho bcang gi sman bzhi yod pa'i phyir te/ rtsabar/ de ni rnam pa bzhi'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyir/ yang sman la rtsabs dbye na dus rung gi sman dang / dus min du rung ba'i sman gnyis yod de/ tshags la ma btsags pa'i bza' ba dus rung gi sman dang / tshags la btsags pa'i btung ba dus min du rung ba yin pa'i phyir te/ phran tshegs las/ btsun pa dus su rung ba ni gang lags/ dus ma yin par rung ba ni gang lags/bka' stsal pa/ nye bar 'khor tshags la ma btsags pa ni dus su rung ba'o/ /tshags la btsags 561
'dulab gzhi smagchus gtor ba ni dus ma yin par rung ba'o/ /zhes rtso/ /dang po bza' ba thams cad dus rung yin te/ ṭīkka las/ dus su rung ba zhes bya ba ni bza' bar bya ba thams cad dus su rung ba nyid yin pas logs shig tu mi brjod de bye brag med pa'i phyir/ zhes dang / rnam bshad rin chen phreng ba'i yang dgongs pa yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ der ma zad la)ga rten na zas su grags pa thams cad yin pa'i phyis sum brgya pa las/ nas gan snum khur 'bras gan nya dang sha /'di dag srog gnas bya phyir bza' bar gsungs/ /sdong bu 'bras bu utpal la sogs sga /de dag bca' ba dus su rung ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyid gnyis pa dus min rung ba yod de/ byin rlabs kyi sman phyi ma gsum gang rung la dus min du rung bas khyab kyang] dus min rung ba la de gsum gang rung gis ma khyab/ dus min rung ba'i btung ba dang rtsab sdong bu sogs kyang yod pa'i phyig dang po grub ste/ sum brgya pa las/ dus min rung ba chung shing 'bras bu la/ /serdzogs pa'i btung ba tshags btsags rung chus bslad/ /dar ba rtsabs dang chur khu sbyar ba'i tshwa/ /bu ram shing khu dang ba 'bru tshwa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub ste/ 'od ldan las/ dus ma yin par rung ba ni dus min rung ba yin te/ thun tshod du rung ba dang / zhag bdun pa dang /ji srid 'tsho ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyir/ khyab lte/ de dag la byin gyis brlabs pa dang ma brlabs pa'i rtsab sdong bu sogs du ma yod pa'i phyir te/ rtsabag yang a ru ra la sogs pa lnga yang ngo / /zhes dang / phran tshegs las/ 'bras bu lnga ni dus sam dus ma yin yang na ba'am mi na bas kyang bza' bar bya ba dag yin no/ /lnga gang zhe na a ru ra dang skyu ru ra dang ba ru ra dang na le sham dang pi pi ling ngo] /zhes gsungs pa'i phyis /bzhi pa phye ba rtso so'i don la bzhi las/ dang 4 mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi/ sgra don gsum/dang 4 ni/ sman gang gtso bor bkres pa sel ba la zhugs pa'i bza' ba'i rigs gnas de dus 562
sman gyi gzhi/rung gi sman gyi mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa mtshan gzhi bza' ba bca' ba rnams te bshad zin/ gsum pa sgra don ni/ de dag chos can/ dus rung zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ chos 'di pa'i rab byung rnams kyis gung tshigs kyi dus tshun chad kho nar spyad du rung bar gnang bas na de ltar brjod pa'i phyir/ ṭīkka las bshad do/ /thun tshod du rung ba la yang gsum las/ dang 4 ni/ sman bzhi 4 gang rung gang zhig /thun tshod kyi mtha' tshun chad du byin gyis brlabs shing longs spyod du rung bar gnang ba'i sman de de'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ dus rung gi rgyu las byung ba'i thun tshod du rung ba dang] zhag bdun pa'i sman las byung ba'i de dang / ji srid 'tsho bcang gi de gsum yod de/ mtshan gzhi rim bzhin rtsam thang ngam rus thang sla ba tshags la btsags pa rung chus btab byin gyis brlabs pa lta bu dang po dang / bu ram khu ba de 'dra gnyis pa dang] a bar skyur gsum gyi khu ba de 'dra gsum pa yin pa'i phyir te/ rtsabag de dus su rung ba nyid yin na thun tshod kyi mtha' yin no/ /gzhan nyid yin na de'i gang yin pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyid gnyis pa mtshan gzhi yod de/ btung ba brgyad sogs de yin pa'i phyig der thal/ thun tshod du rung ba la sla pas khyab pa gang zhig /de la rtsaba'i dbye ba btung ba brgyad dang / yan lag gi dbye ba rtsab mo lnga sogs re re la'ang du ma yod pa'i phyig dang 4 grub ste/ rtsabag zun tshod du rung ba ni bltung ba dag bsto/shin tu sla ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyid gnyis pa grub ste/ sman gzhi'i bar sdom las/chu shing 'bras dang ku shu go la dang / /a zugad tha dang u dum pa ra dang / /su ru sha ka dang ni rgun 'brum dngaka /brgyad pa 'bra go dag ni yin par bshad/ /ces gsungs/ rtsabar yang] tso tshwa dang chu shing gi 'bras bu dang / rgya shug dang a shad tha dang] yu dum bā ra dang] rtsub 'gyur dang / rgun chu dang / 'bra ge'i btung ba rnams ni thams cad du rung ba'o/ /bcos pa'i tshwa dang 'bru'i tshwa dang zho kha chu dngadar ba'i dwangs ma dang rtsab mo chus btab pa tshags kyis btsags pa shin tu sla ba bzhin 563
'dulabagazhismad/snang ba 'dam bu nyan ma'i mdog lta bu dag kyang de dang 'dra'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig 'di lung gling gzhi las bshad pa'o/ /de dag la shun tshod du rung ba zhes bya nyededag byin gyis brlabs pa mtshan mo'i thunadang so'am srod thun tshun chad du sbyad rung la 'das na spyad par mi bya ba'i phyir te/sman gzhi las/ bka' stsal pa/ dge slong btung ba brgyad po 'di dag dus su byin len byas dus su btsags dus su byin gyis brlabs na dus su longs :snad par bya zhing dus ma yin par yang longs spyad par bya la nam gyi thun dang po thal nas ni longs rgyud par mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig 'di dus rung las byung ba yin pas zhib cha dgos te/ rtsabad gzhan nyid yin na de'i gang yin pa'o/ /zhes gsungs 3na/ /sgra bshad 'jug gnyis phan tshun ga la khyab ste phal cher la dogs pa yang ma shar ro/ /de'i byed las yod de/ gtso bor skom pa sel ba'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa zhag bdun pa la yang gsum/ mtshan nyid ni/ sman bzhi po gang rung gang zhig /zhag bdun pa'i mtha' tshun chad du byin gyis brlabs shing longs rgyud par gnang ba'i sman de de yin pa'i phyir te/ rtsabar/ zhag bdun pa dang / zhes gleg/ /mtshan gzhi ni/ bu ram 'bru mar sbrang midang mar dang hwags dang zhag lnga sogs yin pa'i phyir te/ rtsabag zhun mar dang 'bru mar dang sbrang rtsidang bu ram gyi dbu ba dag ni zhag bdun pa'o/ /bu ram dang hwags dang li kha ra la sogs pa thams cad ni bu ram gyi dbu ba nyid kyis 'phangs so/ /bdud rtsini zhun mar dang 'dra ba nyid do/ /zhag bskol zhing btsags pa dag ni 'bru mar dang 'dra ba nyid do/ /nya dang ri bong gi dang chu srin byis pa gsod kyi dang dom gyi dang phag gi'o/ /zhes so/ /byed las yod de/ spyir bkres 'dus gnyis na'i nad dang khyad par du bkres nad dang rlung nad sel bar byed pa'i phyis hwags bu ram gyi phye ma'i rdog 4 dang li kha ra ni ka ra zhes dmar ṭika las bshad/ bzhi pa 'tsho bcang gi de la gsum/ mtshan nyid ni sman bzhi gang rung gang zhig /ji srid 'tsho'i bar du byin gyis brlabs nas bcang du rung 564
sman gyi gzhi/bar gnang ba'i sman de de yin pa'i pyid der thal/ dus rung ma yin pa'i sman la 'tsho bcang gi sman gyis khyab pa'i phyir te/ rtsabad 'tsho ba'i bar du bcang ba ni rtsab dang sdong bu dang 'dab ma dang me tog dang 'bras bu zas kyi don du khyab par byed pa ma yin pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang / ṭīkka las/ gang zas kyi don du khyab par byed pa ma yin pa de dag 'tsho'i bar du bcang ba yin no zhes bya ba'i tha tshig go/zhes dang / 'od ldan las kyang / mdor na bkres pa zhi bar bya ba'i phyir bza' bar bya ba ma yin pa gang yin pa de ni 'tsho ba'i bar du bcang ba'i sman yin par bstan to/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang/ de bcom ldan 'das kyi yang dgongs pa yin pa'i phyir te/sman gzhir rtsab sogs la de ltar bshad pa'i phyir te/ sman gzhi las/ gzhan yang rtsaba'i sman gyi nang du gtogs pa zas kyi don du mi 'gyur ba gang yin pa'o/ /zhes dang] gzhan yang 'bras bu'i sman gyi nang du gtogs pa zas kyi don du mi 'gyur ba gang yin pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs pa'i phyir/ de'i byed las yod de/ sbyor nad dang khyad par 'dus pa'i nad sel ba gtso che ba'i phyir/dbye na rigs bcu sogs yod de/ rtsaba'i dbye ba rtsaba'i dang / sdong bu'i dang / kladab ma'i dang]me tog gi dang / 'bras bu'i dang] trang chu'i dang / thal ba'i dang/ lan tshwa'i dang/ bska ba'i dang]'gyur byed kyi sman gyi bar sogs yod pa'i phyir te/ sman gzhi las/ 'tsho ba'i bar du bcang ba ni rtsaba'i sman dang / sdong bu'i sman dang] lo ma'i sman dang / me tog gi sman dngaka 'bras bu'i sman dang / trang chu lnga dang / thal ba lnga dang / lan tshwa lnga dang / bska ba lnga'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/yan lag gis dbye na nga gsum sogs bshad de/ rigs bcu 4 gzhan la lnga lnga dang] 'gyur byed brgyad bshad pa'i phyig rtsab lnga 'chad par/ gla sgang dang shu dag sogs byung / sdong bu lnga 'chad par tsan dan dang sgyi mo sogs byung / 'dab ma lnga 'chad pag ba sha ka sogs dang / me rtog lnga 'chad pag me tog ni ba sha ka dang sogs byung / 'bras bu lnga 'chad par/ a ru ra dang sogs 565
'dul ba gzhi smadbyung / trang chu 'am sgyi ba lnga 'chad pag sgyi ba'o 'di lta ste shing kun dang sbrang rtsidang sogs byung /'di la spyi byed kyang zeg thal ba lnga 'chad pag lung las/ thal ba lnga gang zhe na nas kyi thal ba dang sogs dang 'dir ni thal ba'o/ /shing spun tsa na dang ka pi ta na dang sogs byung] lan tshwa lnga 'chad pas lan tshwa'o/ /'di lta ste/ rgyam tshwa dang sogs byungad bska ba 'am sman khu lnga 'chad pagsman khu'o gdo ltaste shing a mra dang sogs byung/ 'gyur byed brgyad 'chad pag 'gyur byed do 'di ltaste/til gyidang sogs byung ba'i pyid 'de yang mtshon pa yin la rgyas par grangs med pa yod pa'i phyir dang / 'der yang sman gyi go rim ni dpe'o/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i mig ji srid 'tsho bcang gi don gnyis yod de/ nad ji srid 'tsho dang tshe ji srid 'tsho'i bar bcang ba gnyis yod pa'i pyir/ dang 4 grub ste/ nad ma sos bar du bcang la sos nas 'chang mi rung ba'i sman yod pa'i phyis dper na byin gyis brlabs pa'i sman gsum lta bu min pas pyin rlabs dang spyad mi rung ba'i phyig de bzhin du tshil zhag lnga yang sos na slong na ster ba'am slong med sman khang du 'jog dgos pa bzhin yin pa'i pyir te/ rtsabad sos pa nyid na dedag nad pa'i phyir slong na sbyin no/ /med na sman khang du'o/ /sman khu dang mig sman dag kyang ngo / /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig gnyis pa grub ste/ rnyed dka' ba dang bcang sla ba'i sman byin gyis ma brlabs pa ma shi bar du bzung chog pa'i phyir te/ sum brgya pa las/ sbra tshil bkres ba bsal phyir bza' mi gang / /de dag ma shi bar bcang sman du gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang / zhu ba las/ btsun pa dgung bdun pa'i sman ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bcang bas kyang spang ba'i sgyung byed du mi 'gyur ba lta mchis sam/ nye bar gshor yod de/ zhag bdun tshun chad dus na'o/ /zhes dang / bam lngar 'di 'dra'i don ma go lung ches cher ma dag ces smra mkhan yang byung ngod /lnga pa byin gyis brlab tshul la/ dgos pa/ dngos 4/ gang zag gang] dus/ yun tshad/ cho 566
sman gyibazhi/ga /longs rgyud tshul/ byin rlabs 'jig pa'i rgyu brgyad las/ dang ṭo yod de/ dus thun tshod dang zhag bdun nam ji srid 'tsho'i bar du gsog 'jog dang lag nya sogs mi 'byung ba'i phyir te/rtsabad byin gyis rlabs pa la gsog 'grog mi 'byung ngo / /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig gnyis pa dngos po sman phyi ma gsum gang rung gingo sor grub cing tshad dang ldan padagos te/ de gsum gang rung gi ngo 4 yin kyang lag nya mtshams btsos sogs la byin rlabs mi chags pa'i phyir te/ rtsabar/ lag nyar blangs pa dang gsog lasdog byas pa dang / byin len ma byas pa dang nang du zhag lon pa dang nang du btsos pa dang dge slong gis btsos pa dag la byin gyis rlabs pa mi chags so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa rten gyi gang zag dge slong nad pa kho nas/ yul yod tshe dge slong dgos pa'i phyir te/ rtsabag dang 4 ma yin spru nyid dag ni nad pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig bzhi pa dus ni zas snga ma dus rung gi dus sam snga dro kho na yin te/ rtsabadzas snga ma'i tshe'o/ /zhes dang ṭīkka las/ bskol bdang btsags pa gnyis ni dus su byas kyang rung dus ma yin par byas kyang rung la/ pyin len dang byin gyis rlabs pa gnyis ni dus kho nar bya dbosnas te/ zhes gsungs pa'i sgyig tshil zhag lnga'i skabs su lung gis kyang bshadaltas/ /lnga pa yun tshadani sbyor btang sman gsum po rang rang gi dus kyi mtha'i bar du byin gyis rlabs pa yin te/de las lhag par byin gyis rlabs pa mi chags pa'i phyir te/ rtsabad rang gi dus kyi mtha'i bar byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig dmigs bsal yang 〈snad de/ dus rung gi rgyu las byung ba'i thun tshod du rung ba thun tshod kyi mtha' khon dang/ zhag bdun pa las byung ba bu ram gyi btung ba ltabu thun tshod kyi mtha' 'am zhag bdun gyi mtha' gang rungadang] 'tsho bcang las byung ba'i thun tshod du rung ba ni thun tshod dam ji srid 'tsho gang rung du byin gyis rlabs bde yin pa'i phyir te/ rtsabag de dus su rung ba nyid yin na thun tshod kyi mtha' yin no/ /gzhan nyid yin na de'i 567
'dul ba gzhismad/gang yin pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyis drug pa cho ga yod de/ gyor ba lag pa bkrus byin len byas te snyan gsan phab nas/ dngos gzhi yul de'i mdun du tsog pur bsdad de gnyis das lag pa g.yon pa 'og dang g.yas pas bkab nas/ btsun pa dgongs su gsol/ bdagadage slong ming 7do zhes bgyi pas sman thun tshod du rung ba 'di bdag dang tshangs pa mtshungs par rgyud pa rnams kyi thun tshod du rung ba'i sman du byin gyis brlab bo/ /lan gsum dang mjug thabs legs bya ba yin pa'i phyig de bzhin du sman zhag bdun pa'am ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bcang ba'i sman du zhes sphalhag ma mtshungs so/ /bdun pa longs rgyud tshul yod de/ sbyor btang la byin rlabs can gsum lhan gcig bsres nas longs sbyod mi rung la dus rung dang 'dris na so sor ma phye bar mi rung]'byed ma thub na dus rung ltar byed payin pa'i phyis dmigs bsal mu gedang de 'dra'i dusadang na ba'i tshe lag ltar blangs pa dang mtshams btsos dang zhag lon rjen btsos brtsams ldang gsog 'jog sa 'on sogs 'jig pa/ spangs za dang byin len ma byas par za ba la lhung ba mi 'byung ste/gnang ba'i phyir na mi 'byung ba'i pyir te/ rtsabad mu ge'i tshe dge slong gis btsos pa dang sogs byung ba'i phyir dang] nad gso ba'i phyir du dgos na yang de dag der ma zad rang bzhin dang chang ma gtogs pa'i bcas rkyang mtha' dgadagos na gnang pa'i nyis med yin pa'i phyirate/ rtsabad gso ba'i phyir nub mo za ba ni tshuladang mi mthun pa ma yin no/ /'di la byin len ma byas pa dang sogs dang/ yang rtsabag rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba dang bcas pa las gzhan thams cad las gso ba'i don nyid ma gtogs so zhes bya ba ni lhag ma'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig brgyad pa byin rlabs 'dzig pa'i rgyu yod de/ pyin len 'jig pa'i bcu dang] dus kyi 'phen pa zad pa dang] sngags kyis phyung pa dang ngo bo 'gyur ba sogs bcu gsum sogs kyis 'jig pa'i 69dadrug pa rung khang gcod tshul la du ma yod de/ dgos pa/ gnas/ rten gang gi /dus/ cho 568

sman gyi gzhi/mi bsten pa'i phyig gnyis pa grub ste/ mngon shes med pas de dus 'gyur ba mi shes pas byin gyis mi brlab par thal ba'i skyon yod pa'i phyir te/ rtsabar/ de ni ma yin te/ dus lhag pa la brten na mi chags par 'gyur ba'i phyir dang / de 'byung bar 'gyur pa phal ba rnams kyis bgrod pa ma yin pa'i phyir byin gyis brlab par bya ba nyid ma yin par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs/ yang ldon gyi 'dul 'dzin rgya dang sha mi sogs na re/ rtsabad pyin gyis brlabs pa la gsog langog mi 'byung zhes dang/ yang rtsabad ro dang sla ba nyid yongs su 'gyur na gsog lajug byas pa nyid yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa gnyis 'gal lam zhe na mi 'gal te/ bu ram gyi btung ba zhag bdun par byin gyis brlabs la zhag lnga nas ro dang sla ba gzhan du 'argyur nges de ro dang sla ba nam gyur dus der gsog langog 'byung ba'i sgyid der thal/ de'i tshe de'i byin rlabs zhig la byin len ma zhig pa'i phyir/ zhes pa rgya sha mi mtsho sna ba chen ṭo gsum gyi legs bshad du snang ngo / /'di ltar bshad rgyu med par mkhas rlom kha cig na re/ smad na sman gyi dgag gzhung dka'/zhes grags kyang dka' rgyu med zer ba rang nyid kyi mtshan nyid sgrogs pa'o/ /'de la kha cig na re/bu ram gyi btung ba zhag bdun par byin gyis brlabs pa las bar skabs su ro dang sla ba gzhan du 'gyur ba chos can/ gsog 'dog gi nyes pa rang mtshan pa mi 'byung ste/ pyin len med pa'i phyis khyab lte/ṭīkka las/ byin len ma byas pa la gsog gzhug mi 'byung ngon /zhes gsungs pa'i phyid gong gi rtags grub ste/ ṭīkka las/ sla ba 'ba' zhig yongs su 'gyur na yang banyung bar mi bya ste/ byin len ma byas pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir zer ba la/ snga ma rnams rtags de byin len ma byas pa dang 'dra ba'i don yin zhes gsungs yang spyan rlabs ma byas pa'i phyir zhes pa'i yi ge byin len ma byas par nor bar mngon te/ de ltar ma yin na de'i byin rlabs zhig pa ci yang ma bshad par byin len zhig tshul lan gnyis bshad par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /de ltar dogs 585
'dul ba gzhi smadpa gcod rigs kyang zhib cha 'og tu bya'o/ /yang kha cig na re/ gomatshams/ skabs 'di'i ro dang sla ba gzhan du 'gyur ba na byin len zhig par thal/ de'i tshe sman gyi dngos 4 'gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /ṭīkka las/ 'di gnyis kyis ni de'i ngo bo nyid 'gyur bar bstan te/ zhes dang] rang gi rnam bshad las kyang] ngo bo nyid 'gyur bar bstan te/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir zer na/ mkhas pa kha cig mtsho/ sman gyi gnas skabs kyi ngo bo nyid 'gyur bas byin rlabs 'jig kyang sman rigs kyi ngo bo ma 'gyur bas byin len ma zhig zer ba ṭīkka dang rigs pa gnyis ka dang mi mthun no/ /des na rang lugs la/ rtsabar/ byin gyis brlabs pa la ga〈snag 'jog mi 'byung / zhes pa dang/ yang rtsabs rodang sla ba nyidatsamangs su 'gyur na gsog 'jog byas pa nyidayinano/ /zhes pa gnyisadagongs pa 'gal ba'i skyon med par thal/ de gnyis sbyor btang dmigs bsalasan pas tshig 'gal ba gang zhig/phyi ma dmigs bsal yin pas gtso 'or byed dgos pa'i phyig dang po grub ste/ lung dang pos zhag bdun par byin gyis brlabs pa lta bu yang zhag bdun gyi mtha' tshun chad du lhung ba mi 'byung bar spyir bshad kyang] de'i dmigs bsal zhag bdun gyi sngon du yang ro dang sla ba gang rung re 'gyur na yang 'chang na gsog 'dzog yong bar rjes su bcas pa'i pyiddang 4 grub lte/ ṭīkka las/ gal lte sman zhag bdun pa dang 'tsho ba'i bar du bcang bar byin gyis brlabs par gyur na de la dus de tsam gyis gsog 'jog gi nyes pa mi 'byung ngo] /zhes gsungs pa'i phyid gnyis pa grub ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyis zhag bdun du spyan gyis brlabs kyang 'chang tshad ro dang sla ba'i ngo bo gnyis ma 'gyur bar du 'chang la de nas 'chang mi rung bar bcas pa'i phyir te/ lung sil bu'i bu ram gyi btung ba'i skabs las/ btsun pa btsags pa dgung bdun par byin gyis brlab tu rung ngam/nye bar lugar rung ngo] /btsun pa yun ji srid du bzhag par 'tshal bar bgyi/nye bar gangogashin tu sla zhing mi skyur la rang gi ngo bo nyid mi slong ba de srid du'o/ /zhes 586
sman gyi gzhi/gsungs pa'i phyig khyab ste/ngo bo de gnyis 'gyur na zhag gang la byung ba nas gsog lasdog yong pa'i phyir te/ṭīkka las/ des na btung ba byin rlabs byas shing byin gyis brlabs pa ro dang sla ba nyid yongs su 'gyur na/ rang gi dus kyi mtha'i mdun rol tu gsog lasdog byas pa nyid du 'gyur te/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyid byin rlabs dang byin len yod med gang yin kyang sgyung ba 'byung bar bcas pas spyir btang dang mi 'dra ba ni bcas dbang gis yin no/ /'o na de'i tshe byin len yod dam med ce na/ 'der ṭīkka ltar byin len med kyang gsog lajug gi nyis pa zhig nges par 'ongs te/ de'i dus su mi 'chang bar thub dbang gis dmigs kyis bsal ba dang 'gal ba'i phyis khyab ste/ lung las ltang ba sde lnga lnga'i skabs su 'gal tshab bam 'das pa dang bcas par gsungs pa'i don yod pa'i phyig des na byin len kyang med par mngon te/ sman gyi ngo 'o 'gyur zin pa'i phyir te/ ro mngar ba las skyur ba dang sla ba las ska bar gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /bur shing dang de'i btung ba btsags pa bzhin no/ /des na byin rlabs kyang de dus zhig pa yin te/ byin len zhig pa'i phyir dang / de zhig pa byin rlabs kyi la)ga rgyu yin pa'i pyid 'de la'ang ro dang sla ba cung zad 'gyur na sman rigs nyams mi dgos kyang / de gnyis shin tu 'gyur na sman rigs nyams par 'gyur te/ bu ram gyi ngo ṭo dang btung ba nyams pa'i phyir ro/ /yang reng bu'i du ba rngub pa 'di nad pa ma yin pas mi rung bar thal/ du ba khar rngub padang snar rngub pa mu stegs pa'i brtul zhugs tha chad yin pa'i phyir te/ gzhi 'grel las/ mu stegs kyi dka' chub ces bya ba ni du ba rngub pa la rtsogs pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang sman gce'u sman thur gyi ming yin la/ 'grel chung las smyug ma'i spu gu bshad pa mi 'thad par thal/ phran tshegs 'grel bar paṇa chen tshul khrims bskyangs kyis/ smyug ma'i sbu gus rngub par mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang phyi dar gyi 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i mes ṭo rgyadabang phyug tshul khrims kyis/ sman zhag bdun pa ni gang zag lngas byin gyis 587
'dul bgazhi smad/brlab tu rung ste/ lam du zhugs pa dang dge skosadang lag gi bla dang nad pa ste bzhi dang] zan chad pas kyang byin gyis brlab rung ba'i phyid byas pa la snga phyi'i mkhas mtsho/ pa dang rtog ge ba du ma na re/ dmaradangarjesago]zan chad pas kyang byin gyis brlab tu rung ba'i gzhung med cing] byin gyis brlab tu rung pa'i rkyen dang mi ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /zer ro/ /de dag mi legs par thal/ zan chad kyi cho ga byas pa la de dag gnang bas 'dir yang yang bshad pa'i phyir te/ rtsabag de byin gyis rlabs pa bza' ba la lam du zhugs pa dang dge skos dang lag gi bla rnams nad pa dang 'dra ba nyid yin no/ /zan chad pas kyang de dang dus su rung ba ma yin pa bza' bar rung ngo / /zhes dang/ṭīkka las kyang / dge slong zan chad pas kyang bu ram byin gyis brlabs pa de yang nad pa dang 'dra ba nyid du bzar rung la/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyig lhung byed skabs su yang bshad do/ /des na mang po zhig na re/ zan chad pa'i dbang gis zhag bdun pa'i sman byin gyis brlab tu rung ba mi 'thad de/ de byin rlabs kyi dus snga dro yin la/ zan chad pa'i dus phyi dre'i dus byin rlabs mi rung ba'i phyig zer ba'ang nma 'thad par thal/ 'de'i zan bcad kyi tsho ga byas pa yin gyi de ltar bshad pa ngo tsha'i gnas yin pa'i phyir te/ gsog 'jog ltang byed skabs kyi rtsab las/ zan bcad par byas pa'i 'o/ /nyi ma dang po la spar gang ngo / /gnyis pa la do'o/ /gsum pa la ni ci tsam gyis cho ga pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyis khyab ste/ des zan chad kyi tsho ga bshad pa ltar ṭīkka dang bam lnga sogs kyis bshad pa'i phyis des byin rlabs byas chog tshul drangs zin pa'i phyig yang kha cig na re/ bu ram gyi gong bu chos can/ dus rung gi zas yin par thal/ rnam bshad rin chen 'tsheng ba las/ bu ram drenags ni dus su yang rung ba ste/ 'grel bad bza' ba thams cad dus su rung ba nyid yin pas logs shig tu ma brjod de bye brag med pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes dus thams cad du rung ba'i sman du bshad pas/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ de dus mi rung gi sman 588
'ab kyi gzhi/du bshad pa'i phyig rtsabar 'dod mi nus te/ dus rung gi sman ma yin pa'i phyir te/ rnam bshad rin chen 'phreng ba las/bu ram byin gyis ma brlabs pa yang thams cad du rung bas dang po nyid ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyigsmras pa/bslab pa gsum ldan thos bsam sgom gsum la/ /legs sprungad dge slong dred se skye 4 yang / /pa ṇa 'bum gyi gos dang ro brgya'i zas/ /khang mig lnga brgya mi slob pa bzhin dbang / /sangs rgyas bzhugs dus su yang sde snod gsum/ /'dzin slob dge slong 'ongs na dpag tshad dam/ /rgyang grags sogs su dge 'dun gyis bsu na/ /gangs can ldongs na 'dun sogs dbang gis rol/ /khyad 'phags nye bar gshor dang de'i rjes 'gro/ /'phags yul 'od gnyis chos bshes dge legs bshes/ /ldongs 'di'i thub bltan bdag po rje yab sras/ /skyes rabs nyin byed rlung bas skye rgu skyongs/ /zhes pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /sman gzhi legs par bshad zin to/ /thams cad la 'jug pa las kyi gzhi 'chad par/ cho ga las 'das na las mi chags so/ /'dir cho ga ni dge 'dun tshang ba dang las brjod pa dang / las byed pa nyid do/ /zhes sogs byung / 'di la gling gzhi/ dgos pa/ sgyi don/ mtha' dpyad pa bzhi las/ dang 4 yod de/ drug sdes gcig gis gcig gi dang gcig gis gnyis kyi dang gcig gis mang po'i dang /de bzhin du gnyis kyis gcig gi nas mang po'i dang gcig gis tshogs skya las kyi bar byed/gsum gyis kyang de bzhin dang tshogs kyis gcig nas tshogs kyi bar gyi las byed pa de gsol bas/ gcig gis gcig gi mi bya ba nas/ tshogs kyis tshogs kyi mi bya'o'i bar bcas te/ 'on 589
'dul babazhi smad/kyang las la dbang ba'i dge 'dun lnga yod de/ dge slong bzhi dang lnga dang bcu dang nyi shu dang de las lhag pa'i dge 'dun no/ /zhes tshogs kyi bya ba bzhir ma tshang bas byed pa dang / de bzhin du nyi shu'i bar gyi bya ba de ma tshang bas byas na chos dang 'dul ba ma yin par bcas pa'i phyir/yang mnyan yod du dge slong ma'i dge 'dun bzhi sde lnga sde bcu gnyis sdes las thams cad la gnyis da'i dge 'dun 'dus pa kha nyon sogs la gnod pa gsol bas/ dbyung ba dang /bsnyen rdzogs dang / sgyis bya ba'i las ma gtogs pa la dge slong pha ma'i las so sor gyis zhes bcas pa'i phyir/gnyis pa dgos pa yodade/ las kyi rnam bzhag shes pa la brten nas bsnyen rdzogs sogs kyi las de dang de chags pas rang rang gi 'bras bu bsnyen rdzogs sogs 'grub cing brgya rtsa'i grangs bshad pas lung ma dag pa'i tsho ga mi 'jug pa'i ched yin pa'i phyisgsum pa la cho ga'i rnam bzhag dang / las kyi rnam bzhag dngos gnyis/ dang po la cho ga'i ngo 'o dang / de'i khyad par bshad pa gnyis/ ngo 4 yod de/ dge 'dun grangs tshang zhing kha skong 'os pa'i las byed kyis las gsum ci rigs ma 'khral bar brjod nas nyams su myong ba'i thabs de de yin pa'i pyir ro/ /gabar/ 'dir cho ga ni dge 'dun tshang ba dang las brjod pa dang las byed pa nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig ṭīkka las kyang / zhes bya ba ni cho ga'i rnam pa bstan te/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa de'i khyad par la las chags pa'i gzhi'i yan lag /bsam pa'i yan lag /las brjod pa'i ngo bo'i yan lag /las thos pa nyams su myong ba'i yan lag /las chags pa'i dus kyi yan lag lnga las/ dang so la gsum yosnad de/ blo mthun gyi gzhi dge 'dun/ rjod par byed pa'i las mkhan/ gang la sgrub pa'i bsgrub bya gsum yod pa'i phyid dang 4 khyad par gsum ldan dgos te/ grangs tshang ba/ kha skong 'os pa/ mi mthun pa gnyis 590
