'dul ba gzhi smaddang gzhu dang gdung stan dang gdung dang gdung khebs dang mchod rtseg dang khebs dang pad mchod serdzogs lha'i khang pa bzhin sgrub pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa gtsang khang gi khyad par 〈snad de/ gtsug lag khang de'i phug gi ngos sam/ phug gi phyogs gcig tu dri gtsang khang ngam sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzhengs pa'i khang pa slo g.yas g.yon du gnas khang byed pa yin pa'i phyidade bzhin du gtsang khang gsum byed na mdzes pa'i phyir dungosade'i dbus dang g.yas g.yon du re re ste dgu byed la/ de'i sgo gtsug lag khang gi pyi sgodang mthun par byas na mun pa chung ba'i phyig zuradang sa grub lte/ rtsabdangos gcig gi dbus su dri gtsang khang bya ba nyid do/ /zhes dang/ṭīkka las/ 'dir ngos zhes bya ba ni phyogs te/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyis lung las kyangaka gal te gnas khang gsum pa byed du bcug na dbus su dri gtsang khang byed du bzhug cing slo gnyis su gnas khang gnyis so/ /sogs gsungs pa'i sgyid gnyis pa grub lte/ rtsabag de'i mdun du sgo khang ngo] /zhes gsungs pa'i phyislnga pa khyams kyi khyad par yod de/ khyams gcig pa dang khyams gsum pa yang yod pa'i phyig der thal/dri gtsang khang gcig la g.yas g.yon du gnas khang re byas na khyams gcig byed/ de 'dra'i dri gtsang khang gsum dang khang mig dgu yin na/ khyams gsum pa byed pa dang] de bzhin du bzhi pa byed pa drenags yin pa'i phyir te/ rtsabar/ khyams gsum pa yang ngo / /zhes dang / lung las kyang/ gal te gnas khang gsum pa byed du 'jug na dbus su dri gtsang khang byed du gzhug cing slo gnyis su gnas khang gnyis dreg/ /khyams gsum lanide bzhin du gnas khang dgudag theto/khyams bzhi la ni dbus su sgo khang gi byang gtad du dri gtsang khang ngo / /sgo khang gi ngos gnyis su gnas rnyi dā spri /pa rnyi/ shā/ ryaṃ kā snyisna~X ༵ ༷rnyi / ṇā pa~X rsha stu sna (sna spya gasnrorsha rnyiX ༷rshaspya/ pasdi krā steng du rgyan mang ngos mdzes par byas pa de'i ming la rta babs dang go dang 4 dang lam 4 che'i 650
gnas mal gyi gzhi/sgo sogs su grags pa de yin pa'i phyir te/ lung las/ mchod rten la lan zhan gyis bskor ba de la rta babs med pas mi mjes par gyur nas bka' stsal pa rta babs sgreng bar bya'o/ /zhes dang / rnam 'byed 'grel ba dang gzhi 'grel las/ rta babs zhes bya ba ni lam 4 che'i sgo mthon 4 sgreng ba'o/ /zhes dang / phran tshegs 'grel ba las/ rta babs ni rtsaba'i sgo'i phyi rol gyi rtsig pa ma gtogs par shing gnyis sgreng ba la shing gcig gis steng nas bkab pa sgo'i rnam pa lta bu yin te/ 'de'i ming gzhan ni sgodang ṭo zhes bya ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i pyid 'grel chung gis rta babs rdo ring du bshad pa nor ro/ /lan kun ni shing thag yin te/ shing gi dbyug pa ring po 'phreng la thag pa ltar btang ba ni lan dzin dang] de mi 'gul ba'i ched du shing thung ngu gyen la 'greng ba dang sbrel ba ni shar bu'am shar ba zhes bshad pa'i phyir te/ da lta rab gsal sogs la shing gi dra mig gam shing thag byas pa lta bu yin pa'i phyir te/ rtsabad mi ltang bar bya ba'i phyir lan zhan bya'o/ /mi 'gul bar bya ba'i phyir shar ba bzhag go/zhes dang /ṭīkka las/ 'dir shar ba zhes bya ba ni lan spun gyi shing ring po rnam par bzhag pa'i bar du gzungs kyi shing zung ngu gang dag 'dzud pa de dag la bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i sgyid 'grel chung las kyang ngo] /gsum pa rgya dpangs kyi khyad par gnyis yod de/ dge slong pha'i gtsug lag khang gzhan lnga brtsegs dang gtsang khang dang sgo khang gnyis rab gsal ltabu bdun brtsegs byed/ dge slong ma'i gtsug lag khang gzhan sum brtsegasadang gtsang khang sgo khang gnyis rab gsal ltabu lnga brtsegs byed cing rgya tshad kyang des dpyad rigs pa'i phyig dang po grub ste/ rtsabar/ gtsug lag khang dag gi brtsegs ma nyid kyi mtha' ni lnga'o/ /zhes dang / lung sil bu las/ dge slong rnams kyi gtsug lag khang ni lnga brtsegs su bya'o/ /dri gtsang khang ni bdun brtsegs so/ /sgo khang steng gi bsil khang yang bdun brtsegs so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub ste/ rtsabad dge slong 651
'dul ba gzhi smadma rnams kyi brtsegs ma nyid ni gsum mo/ /zhes dang / lung sil bu las/ dge slong ma rnams kyi gtsug lag khang ni sum brtsegs su bya'o/ /dri gtsang khang ni lnga brtseg go/sgo khang gi steng gi bsil khang yang lnga brtseg go/zhes gsungs pa'i pyid bzhi pa dbyibs kyi khyad par du ma yod de/ gtsug lag khang gi dbyibs su gru bzhi bzang la zur brgyad zlum po sogs kyang rung] khyams yang gtsug lag khang gru bzhi pa la byang ma yin pa'i ngos gsum du khyams dbus mthong che ba ma gtogs ka tshar byas thog 'bub pa la khyams mdun ngos su pyi nang rim gsum sogs dang /phyogs bzhi nas khyams btags pa sogs kyang rung ba'i phyid dang po grub ste/ rtsabag gru bzhi bzang ba nyid do/ /zhes dang] ṭīkkar yang / gtsug lag khang gi dbyibs gru bzhi pa nyid bzang ste /rdzu lha paXn paX (lhab rsha snro ༷༷ ṭwāṃ/na/ kto/sa/ /shāka༈ rnyi sna/spya ༵ parsha sngu / 〈sna sna/ (5 rlo gzugs can spha /gang gang dri yi gtsang khang 'di/ /gru bzhi par yang lta bar spha /de lta'i gzugs rnams mngon 'dod pas/ /de snyed cha shas rnams kyang spha /zhes gsungs pa'i nyid rtags gnyis pa grub ste/ me tog 'phreng rgyud las/ phal cher ga〈snags shing kun nas bskyod /ngos bzhi pa yi khyams bzhin brtags/ /thams cad ga'angags shing phal cher bskog /ngos gnyis pa yi khyams bzhin te/ zhes dang / rtsabar yang] khyams gsum pa yang ngo] /zhes dang] ṭīkka las/ gru bzhi la ngos gsum nas khyams brtags pa bzang ngo / /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ lnga pa gtsug lag khang khyams dang bcas pa'i yan lag gi khyad par yod de/ de dag la thun mong du steng du la)ga pa'i rdo sa shing gi zem skas gsum dang shing smig ma thag pa'i ya gad gsum gang rung byed la/ khyams kyi dbus su seng ge'i rṇi rgyanadang rkang rten dang bcas/ steng du bla re dar dbyangs/ gnas de dag gi gnyor gyi khyams zlum 4 dang] bsil ba'i ched du phyi rtsigs pas bskor ba ka tshar gyis thog 652
gnas mal gyibaston/phug cing bser shu ldang ba'i ched du skar khung dra ba'am sgo glegs can chu'i rdzing bu sogs byed/rab byung gi kun dga' ra ba rtsig pas bskor ba dang] de'i pyi rol tu shing btsugs pa'i gtsangs (rtsangs)dang 'obs sogs byed pa'i phyis dang 4 grub ste/ rtsabag 'dzegs pa'i phyir them skas bya'o/ /'og tu rdo las byas pa bar du sa las byas pa steng du shing las byas pa'o/ /ya gad las gzer bar bya'o/ /shing dang smig ma dang thag pa las byas pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyis ya shing gcig la rkang pa 'jog pa de gsum gyis byas pa yin par phran tshegs 'grel bar bshad/gnyis pa grub ste/ rtsabar/ seng ge'i rṇi gru bzhi bya'o/ /sogs dang] steng du bla re'o/ /dbyangs pa dag bosna/zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa grub lte/ rtsabad gnar gyi khyams bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyid bzhi pa grub ste/ rtsabar/ gnas bsil bar bya ba'i phyir phyi rol rtsig pas bskor ro/ /nas/ dra ba dang sgo glegs dag gzhug go/zhes 〈sna/ /lnga pa grub ste/ rtsabag rab tu byung ba'i kun dga' ra ba rtsig pas bskor ba nyid kyang ngo] /rtsig pa la chu khung gdod pa nyid kyang ngo / /gtsangs (tsangs)dang 'obs dag kyang lnga1 /zhes gsungs pa'i mig 'di dag gi sgo glegs kyi khyad pag rtsabar gsal bas ma spros so/ /drug pa ri mo'i khyad par yod de/ gtsug lag khang gi khyams su ston pa'i skyes rabs sogs skyes rabs kyi sde nas byung ba'i ri mo dang / dpangs mtho ba'i khang par shā ri'i bu sogs bri ba dang / dri gtsang khang gi sgor gnod sbyin phreng thogs bri ba nas/ chu khang du klu'i bu mo bri ba'i bar dang / sgo khang gi lubor yug tu cho 'phrul chen 4 dang / bdud bcom tshul dang /mchod rten byed tshul dang / dge 'dun gyi gtsug lag khang dang gang zag gi gnas khang la yang zad par gyi ting nge 'odzin bzhi skyes pa'i ched du kha dog rdzo ser dmar dkar byed cing bden bzhi'i mtshan ma bri ba rnams yin pa'i phyir/ dang po grub lte/ gabar khyams su skyes rabs dag 653
'dul ba gzhi smadgo/zhes sogs dang / me tog 'phreng rgyud las/ khang bzang mtshog gi ngos dag tu/ /thub pa'i gron gyi skyes pa'i rabs/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i pyid gnyis pa grub ste/ rtsabad dpangs mtho ba'i khang par gnas brtan gyi gral dag go /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ dpangs mtho ba ni tshogs pa yin te/ me tog phreng rgyud las/ kun las 'du ba'i khang par ni/ /brtul ldan rgan zhing rgan pa rnams/ /chos dang mngon brjod 'chad par ni/ /byed pa mngon par gnas pa bri/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa grub ste/ rtsabar/ dri gtsang khang gi sgor/ zhes pa nas/ klu'i bu mo chu 'brim par byed pa dag go /zhes so/ /bzhi pa grub ste/ rtsabar/ de'i kho ra khor yug tu cho 'phrul chen 4 dang bdud bcom pa dag go/zhes so/ /lnga pa yod de/ ston pa 'das dus dbu byang du ston pa gnang ba'i rgyu mtshan dang / sangs rgyas sogs kyi mchod rten gyi khyad par gnyis yod pa'i sgyig dang po grub ste/ phran tshegs 'grel ba las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di skad du/nga yongs su mya ngan las 'das na/ byang phyogs kyi rtogs pa dang / bsam gtan dang zlos te klog pa'i sgo nas/ nga'i bltan pa rab tu gsal bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes rgyas par rgyu mtshan bstan to/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa mchod rten gyi khyad par yod de/ ngo 'o chos skur mtshon pa'i zugs kyi rten dang / dbye na bum par gtsang khang ngam lha khang yod pa'i gtsang khang can dang / de med pa'i ka ba lta bu gnyis dang / yul gyis phye na sangs rgyas kyi mchod rten bang rim nas char khebs bar tshang ba dang / char khebs med pa'i rang sangs rgyas kyi de dang /so skye la gdugs med pa dang / rgyun zhugs kyi gdugs gnyis can dang / phyir 'ong gi gsum can dang / phyir mi 'ong gi bzhi can dang / dgra bcom pa'i gdugs lnga ba'i bar yod pa'i phyir/shes byed rim pa bzhin du/ zhu 'grel las/ mchod rten gyi gnas ni chos kyi sku ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi sku'i bdag nyid dran pa nye bar bzhag pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang /654
gnas mal gyibaskon/dbang po dang / stobs lnga dang / byang chub kyi yan lag dang / mkhyen pa dang / stobs bcu dang /zugs rje chen po la sogs pa'i thugs kyi yon tan rnams kyi gzugs can nyid du bslangs pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes dang] rtsabag mchod rten ni rnam pa gnyis te/ gtsang khang can nyid dang ka ba lta bu nyid do/ /nas/ 'phags pa la ni mchod rten gyi dus ston rigs so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig drug pa yod de/ rtsabad gron 4 la sogs pa zad par gyi mtshan ma mngon du bya ba'i phyir gnas khang gi rtsig pa dag sngon 4 la sogs pa rnam pa bzhir bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyid bdun pa grub ste/ rab byung rnams kyi rang gi gnas khang gtsug lag khang gi sgor bden rnyishā mp+raṃ ma/ku pa'i 'a rnyi( spya lha ༈ rlo /su ngaparsha (lha/ rnyishā mp+raṃ ra//spya bri ba/sna mi nāX/na sprispri ba hāX bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ dang 4 yod de/ mi rtag pa'i srin po'i sto bar ram/ bang bar srid pa'i 'khor 'ordzo rim pa gsum pa'i rim pa gnyis pa la cha lngar byas pa'i steng du lha mi gnyis 'og ma gsum langan song gsum bris/ mi'i gnas su gling bzhi srid pa bar ma brgyudanas skye bsang 'bri ba de yin pa'i phyir te/ rtsabag sgo khang du pangor ba'i 'khor lo'o/ /cha lnga par bya'o/ /steng du lha dang mi rnams so/ /gling bzhi po dag go/rdzus te skyes pa'i sems can zo chun gyi 'khyud mo bzhin du 'chi 'pho ba dang skye ba dag kyang yod /zhes gsungs pa'i pyid gnyis pa yod de/ dbus kyi lte bar kun 'byung gi gtso bo 'dod chags phug ron dang zhe snang sprul gnyis kyi mjug ma gti mug phag gis za bar bris pas dug gsum gtso bo de yang ma rig pa gtso che bar shes pa'i phyir te/rtsabag dbus su 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gnyi mug dag /phug ron dang sprul dang phag gi rnam par ro/ /snga ma de gti myag gis za bar ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig dug gsumade'i dbang gis 'khor bar 'khor tshul yan lag bcu gnyis kyi mtshan ma 〈snad de/ rin chen rlung ba las ma 655
'dul ba gzhi tshogrig pa bud med ma 'dris pa sogs bri bar bshad/ rnam 'byod 'grel par bye brag bshad mtsho drangs pa las/ ma rig pa ni bud med bri bar bya'o/ /'du byed rdzamakhan snod byed pa'o/ /rnam par shes pani spre'u gzugs so/ /mingadang gzugasani skyes pa dang bud medado/ /skye mched drugani skye mched drug po de dag yul thadad pa la chags pa dag go/reg pa ni bud med dang skyes pa'i lus mi sna /lha ṭwāṃ // athi+-i dī ('o/le/༈ dī ghnā /lha rdzu/pa paX ༈ rshadī ba pa rtswa par ñtsha pazlo/da /59 mngal na gnas pa de nyid skye ba'o/ /rga ba ni skyes pa rgas shing gshog pa'o/ /shi ba ni mi 3 ba'i gzugs su bri ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig yang ma rig pa rgan mo long ba dang / 'du byed rdza byed pa/ rnam shes spre'u/ ming gzugs gru mkhan/ skye mched grong stong/ sogs bshad/ sprul pa'i glegs bam ltaradeng dus phyag len gtso bor byas snang ngo] /de skad sa rtsabag kho ra khor yug du yan lag bcu gnyis thams cad mi rtag pa nyid kyis bzung bar ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/gsum pa yod de/ 'gog bden mthar shug myang 'das mtshon pa'i dkyil gshor dkar po dri ma med pa mun pa sel ba'i 'od can mi rtag pa'i srin po'i steng du bris te/ de ston pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gzugs bridagos pa'i sgyig ②bad lteng du myangan las 'das pa'idakyil 'khor nye bar ston pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir bzhi pa yodade/ lam bden bsgom pa'i mtshan ma thar pade'i 'og tu/ brtsam par bya zhing dbyung bar sga /'dam bu'i khyim la glang chen bzhin/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gnyis bri dgos pa'i phyig rtsabar/ 'og tu brtsam par bya zhing zhes bya ba'i tshegs bcad gnyis po de ston par byed pa bzhag par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyis drug pa gang gi don gyi khyad par yodade/ dge 'dunadang gang zag gi ched du byas pa sogasazungad pa'i pyidbzhi pa de skyong tshul gyi khyad par yod de/ rgyun gyi tshogs bsags thabs mchod pa'i sgo 656
gnas 655 gyi gzhi/nas skyong tshul dang / thams cad kyi bsod nams rlabs chen gsog pa dus ston gyi sgo nas skyong tshul sogs yod pa'i phyir/ dang 4 'chad pag rtsabag khang skyong gi gtsug lag khang nyi ma re re bzhin phyag dar bya'o/ /zhes sogs dngaka 'og tu yang rtsabag rgyal mtshan dag gzug bo /de ni rnam pa bzhi'o/ /seng ge'i rgyal mtshan dang / chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan dang / klu'i rgyal mtshan dang / khyu ma:snag gi rgyal mtshan no/ /zhes pa nas rin po che las byas pa'i phreng ba dbul lo / /dre gas gsungs pa'i phyig gnyis pa grub ste/ sku bltams dus/ gtsug phud bzhag dus/dbu skra bcad dus/ mngon par byang chub pa'i dus dag tu dus ston byed pa'i rna rgyan dang / rkang rgyan min pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan te/ lha mi dri za sdugags kyi cha byad glu gar zung serdzor byed cing / rnga 'o che rnga pa ṭa ha sogs kyi rol mo dang khyogs sam khang bzang du sku gzugs gdugs du ma rgyal mtshan du mas brgyan te grong so sor zha4ra bar byed pas chos dang 'jig rten gyi bde legs thams cad phyogs thams cad du 'byung ba de yin pa'i phyir te/ rtsabad sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs bya'o/ /de la dus ston bya'o/ /bltams pa dang gtsug phud dang dbu skra dang byang chub pa'i dus ston dag kyang cad /zhes pa nas/ de la rol mo byed pa dag gis rol mo bya ba dang/ bkur lha tāshā ༵ gaX/ rdzu dī shā/ dī ( /'phru/ ༵ snyed /napagonarsha/ dī /lha /dpa spra (zi shaṃ ghnā (sngapa /shā te yun ring gnas gyur cig /ces gsungs pas se / /smras pa/rgya mtsho bzhi las chu 'dzin sna tshogs thams cad dam/ /ma dros mtsho las 'dzam gling klung rnams 'byung ba bzhin/ /zla med srid zhi'i bla ma shākya seng ge'i bstan/ /srid zhi'i chu 657
